english: Castrocalbón lies in the Valdería country south of Astorga. Its houses cluster below a small height occupied first by an Iron Age hillfort and later by a medieval castle. The settlement had its own fuero, a body of local law setting out the rights of the lord and council and regulating affairs such as markets. Beneath the castle stands the church of El Salvador, whose brickwork bears the influence of Mudéjar building traditions.
simp_chinese: 卡斯特罗卡尔冯位于阿斯托加以南的巴尔德里亚地区，民居聚集在一座小丘脚下；丘上先有铁器时代的山堡，后来又建起中世纪城堡。聚落拥有自己的地方特许法，规定领主和市议会的权利，并管理集市等事务。城堡下方的萨尔瓦多教堂以砖砌结构显示出穆德哈尔建筑传统的影响。

english: Castrojeriz stretches along the road to Santiago at the foot of a castle hill west of Burgos. Its long street, churches and former pilgrim hospitals bear the imprint of the journey across the Castilian plateau. In 974 Count García Fernández granted the town a fuero that established local rights and became a model for other settlements in the surrounding territory. The castle above the town and the charter below it together recall Castrojeriz's early role on the Castilian frontier.
simp_chinese: 卡斯特罗赫里斯位于布尔戈斯以西，沿通往圣地亚哥的道路在城堡山脚下伸展。长街、教堂和昔日朝圣者救济院都留下横穿卡斯蒂利亚高原的旅程的印记。974年，伯爵加西亚·费尔南德斯授予城镇特许法，确立地方权利，并成为周边聚落的法律范本。山上的城堡与镇上的特许法共同见证了卡斯特罗赫里斯在早期卡斯蒂利亚边境的地位。

english: Castropol occupies a small promontory overlooking the estuary of the Eo, opposite the coast of Galicia. Its medieval stronghold, the Castillo Fiel, served as both a fortress and a residence of the bishop. Repairs to the castle and its keep began in 1526, but in 1587 a disastrous fire swept through the town and destroyed most of its houses. Castropol was rebuilt in the following centuries, with noble residences taking prominent places among its streets.
simp_chinese: 卡斯特罗波尔占据埃奥河口的一处小岬角，与加利西亚海岸隔水相望。中世纪的菲耶尔城堡既是要塞，也是主教的居所。1526年，人们开始修缮城堡及其主塔；但1587年一场大火席卷城镇，摧毁了大部分房屋。此后的数百年间，卡斯特罗波尔逐渐重建，贵族宅邸在街巷中占据显眼位置。

english:
Castrovillari stands below the mountains of the Pollino in northern Calabria, commanding routes between the highlands and the plain of the Crati. Its old town grew around an earlier fortress, churches and gates. In the fifteenth century the Aragonese rulers strengthened their hold on the town with a new castle at the opposite end of the settlement, near the old gate known as Porta della Catena. Its four towers gave the new fortification a strong outline.

Completed around 1490, the castle carried an inscription celebrating King Ferdinand's authority. It formed part of a wider programme of fortification after unrest and baronial conspiracies in the Kingdom of Naples. The imposing walls guarded a strategic place, while also reminding Castrovillari's inhabitants of the king's power over their town.
simp_chinese:
卡斯特罗维拉里位于卡拉布里亚北部波利诺山脚下，控制山地与克拉蒂平原之间的道路。旧城围绕早期堡垒、教堂和城门发展。十五世纪，阿拉贡统治者在聚落另一端的锁链门附近修建新城堡，加强对城镇的控制。四座塔楼构成堡垒鲜明的轮廓。

城堡约于1490年完工，铭文颂扬斐迪南国王的权威。那不勒斯王国经历骚乱与贵族阴谋后，王室在多地加强防御，卡斯特罗维拉里便是其中之一。雄伟的城墙守卫战略要地，也提醒居民国王对城镇的权力。

english:
Cát Tiên lies in the southern highlands near the Đồng Nai River. Along the river stands an ancient sanctuary of brick temples and mounds, where worshippers honoured Hindu gods. A great stone linga and its basin reveal the importance of Shiva, while small gold sheets bear images of deities and sacred symbols. The sculptures show affinities with both Cham and Khmer traditions, yet possess local characteristics of their own. The sanctuary was already old long before the later kingdoms of the region arose.

The later city of Gia Nghĩa lies here.
simp_chinese:
吉仙位于南部高地，靠近同奈河。河畔有一处古老圣地，由砖砌神庙和土丘构成，信众在此祭奉印度教诸神。巨大的石制林伽及其基座显示了湿婆的重要地位，小金片上则刻有神祇和圣洁符号。这里的雕塑兼具占婆与高棉传统的相似之处，同时保留地方特色。当地后来的诸王国兴起之前，这座圣地便已有悠久历史。

后来的嘉义市即位于此地。

sources.title: Lost Kingdoms Hindu Buddhist Sculpture of Early Southeast Asia.pdf

english: The plateau around Caldas lies in the hills of southern Minas Gerais. As the gold workings of the captaincy declined, settlers moved into this upland country and established farms and cattle estates. A settlement emerged toward the end of the eighteenth century, and in 1813 the parish of Rio Verde das Caldas was created. Its landscape of hills and watercourses gave the community a setting distinct from the older mining towns.
simp_chinese: 卡尔达斯周围的高原位于米纳斯吉拉斯南部群山中。随着总督领的金矿衰落，定居者迁入这片高地，建立农场和牧牛庄园。十八世纪末，这里出现了一处聚落；1813年设立卡尔达斯里奥韦尔迪堂区。丘陵与河道交错的地貌使它有别于较早的矿业城镇。

english: The country later known as Nova Serrana lies in the upper São Francisco basin of Minas Gerais. A settlement emerged here in the eighteenth century, as prospectors sought precious metals in the interior. Cattle ranches already occupied much of the São Francisco valley, and farms and stopping places grew along the tracks connecting this country with the mining districts. The settlement became known as Cercado, after an enclosure used for travellers’ animals.
simp_chinese: 后来称为新塞拉纳的地区位于米纳斯吉拉斯的圣弗朗西斯科河上游流域。十八世纪，寻矿者在内陆寻找贵金属时，这里出现了一处聚落。当时圣弗朗西斯科河谷已有许多牧牛庄园，通往矿区的道路旁也兴起农场和歇脚处。聚落后来称为塞尔卡杜，得名于供旅人关放牲畜的围栏。

english: Catahoula is associated with the great shallow lake of central Louisiana, a place of marshes, open water and seasonally flooded ground. The name has been traced to a Tensas word for a large clear lake. Water levels change greatly through the year, exposing mudflats and vegetation when the lake recedes. Its wetlands lie within a country crossed by the Ouachita, Tensas and Black rivers, where waterbirds gather and the courses of streams shape the lowlands.
simp_chinese: 卡塔胡拉与路易斯安那中部的大型浅湖有关，那里遍布沼泽、开阔水面和季节性淹水的土地。这个名称被认为源自滕萨斯语中“大而清澈的湖”。湖水水位随季节大幅变化，退水时露出泥滩和植被。湿地位于瓦希托河、滕萨斯河与黑河纵横的地区，水鸟在此聚集，河道塑造着低地的面貌。

english: Şatak lies southeast of Lake Van, in a landscape of deep valleys and oak-covered mountains. Its streams descend through a district long inhabited by Armenian and Kurdish communities, where churches and stone bridges mark the routes between scattered settlements. The area belonged to the Armenian kingdom of Vaspurakan and later came under the lords of Hakkari. In 1548 it passed into the Ottoman realm; monasteries continued to stand among the surrounding villages.
simp_chinese: 沙塔克位于凡湖东南方，周围深谷纵横，山坡上覆盖橡树林。溪流流过这片亚美尼亚人与库尔德人长期居住的地区，教堂和石桥点缀着连接各个聚落的道路。这里曾属于亚美尼亚瓦斯普拉坎王国，后来归哈卡里领主管辖。1548年，沙塔克进入奥斯曼疆域；周围村庄之间仍有修道院矗立。

english:
Çatalca spreads across the Thracian ridge between the Sea of Marmara and the Black Sea, northwest of Constantinople. Forests, fields, springs and rolling uplands make the district a broad rural approach to the imperial city. Roads from the capital crossed the ridge toward Adrianople and the Balkan frontier, while coastal valleys gave access to the Marmara shore.

The ancient town of Ergisce belonged to the Propontis region, its name linked in myth to Ergiscus, son of Poseidon. Under Rome the place was known as Metrae and became a suffragan bishopric in the late province of Europa, subject to the metropolitan see of Heraclea. Byzantine churches and roads preserved its position within the ecclesiastical and military geography of eastern Thrace.

Ottoman conquest placed Çatalca within the rural hinterland of Constantinople. Villages combined grain farming, stock raising and forest work, and the ridge carried traffic between the capital and the Balkan provinces. Greek, Turkish and other communities occupied the district’s valleys and villages over the centuries. Çatalca’s importance came from this passage across Thrace, where land routes and coastal waters converged northwest of the capital.
simp_chinese:
恰塔尔贾位于马尔马拉海与黑海之间的色雷斯山脊，处在君士坦丁堡西北。森林、田地、泉水与起伏高地使县域成为通往帝都的广阔乡郊。从都城出发的道路越过山脊通往阿德里安堡和巴尔干边疆，沿海谷地则可进入马尔马拉海岸。

古代埃尔吉斯切城属于普罗蓬提斯地区，神话把名称同波塞冬之子埃尔吉斯库斯联系起来。罗马统治下，此地称梅特拉伊，在欧罗巴行省晚期成为赫拉克利亚都主教区下属的主教区。拜占庭教堂与道路使其继续处于东色雷斯宗教和军事地理之中。

奥斯曼征服后，恰塔尔贾进入君士坦丁堡的乡村腹地。村庄兼营谷物、牲畜与林业，山脊承载都城和巴尔干各省之间的交通。希腊人、土耳其人及其他社群长期分布在谷地和村庄。恰塔尔贾的重要性来自这条穿越色雷斯的通道，陆路与海岸水域在都城西北交汇。

english: Catalte was a small Indigenous province of the lower Arkansas country, in a landscape of bayous and floodplain forest. One reconstruction places it along Bayou Bartholomew. In 1542 Luis de Moscoso led the survivors of the de Soto expedition away from Guachoya and through this region in search of a route to Mexico. Beyond the bayous, their journey crossed oak, hickory and pine forests toward the interior.
simp_chinese: 卡塔尔特是阿肯色河下游地区的一处小型原住民部族地区，周围分布着河汊与洪泛平原森林。一种路线复原将它置于巴索洛缪河汊沿岸。1542年，路易斯·德·莫斯科索率德索托远征队的幸存者离开瓜乔约，穿过这一地区寻找通往墨西哥的道路。越过河汊之后，他们继续穿行于橡树、山核桃和松树组成的内陆森林。

english:
Catan Lil belongs to Puelmapu, the traditional Mapuche territory east of the Andes. The name covers a vast region that joins mountain approaches with the plains of Patagonia and the Pampas. This breadth matters: Puelmapu is not a single town or province but a Mapuche geography whose many communities were connected across open country, river routes and the eastern side of the Andes.

Catan Lil should therefore be placed within a wider social landscape rather than treated as an isolated point. After that campaign, Puelmapu became part of Argentina.

The records also records persistent disputes over rights, displacement and the defence of ancestral land. Catan Lil's history is inseparable from this long contest over how plains and Patagonian spaces are governed, who may belong there, and how Mapuche territorial identity survives within the later state. Pastoral routes crossed the open country.
simp_chinese:
卡坦利尔属于普埃尔马普，即安第斯山以东的马普切传统地域。这个名称覆盖从临山地带延伸到巴塔哥尼亚与潘帕平原的广阔区域。它并非某座城镇或单一省份，而是一片由许多社群共同维系的马普切地理空间；开阔乡野、河道和安第斯山东侧把这些社群联系起来。

因此，卡坦利尔应放在更大的社会生活范围中理解，不能当成孤立的地点。

背景同时记录了围绕土地防卫、流离失所和权利保障持续存在的争议。卡坦利尔的历史与这场长期争夺不可分割：平原和巴塔哥尼亚空间应如何治理、谁有权归属于此，以及马普切地域身份如何在后世国家中延续，都仍然是核心问题。牧场、盐路和季节性水源继续联系安第斯东侧社群。

english:
Catania stands on Sicily's eastern coast beneath Mount Etna, where the fertile volcanic slopes meet the Ionian Sea. Founded by Greek settlers from Naxos, the city passed through Roman, Byzantine, Islamic and Norman hands. Its cathedral and the massive Castello Ursino recall the medieval city, while its university, founded in the fifteenth century, made it a centre of learning.

In 1669 lava from Etna reached Catania, surrounded the castle and advanced into the sea. The city walls diverted much of the flow, though some lava entered the town and the harbour was damaged. A still greater disaster followed in 1693, when an earthquake devastated Catania. Reconstruction transformed its streets and churches, using dark volcanic stone in the buildings of a new Baroque city.
simp_chinese:
卡塔尼亚坐落在西西里东岸的埃特纳火山脚下，肥沃的火山坡地在此与爱奥尼亚海相接。城市由来自纳克索斯的希腊移民建立，后来先后经历罗马、拜占庭、伊斯兰和诺曼统治。大教堂与雄伟的乌尔西诺城堡保存着中世纪城市的记忆，十五世纪建立的大学则使它成为学术中心。

1669年，埃特纳熔岩抵达卡塔尼亚，包围城堡并流入大海。城墙挡开了大部分熔岩，但一部分仍进入城内，港口也受到损毁。1693年的地震造成更大灾难，城市几乎毁灭。重建改变了街道和教堂的面貌，深色火山石被用于新建的巴洛克城市。

english:
Catanzaro stands on hills above the narrow waist of Calabria, between the Tyrrhenian and Ionian seas. Its elevated position made it a natural stronghold, while silk manufacture helped the city become a commercial centre. Under the Ruffo family it commanded a substantial territory, and its workshops connected the surrounding countryside with markets beyond the mountains.

During the struggle between France and Spain for southern Italy, French forces besieged Catanzaro in 1528 but failed to take it. The city's resistance earned it the title Magnifica et Fidelissima, displayed together with the imperial eagle on its arms. In 1783 a succession of earthquakes struck Calabria and badly damaged Catanzaro, bringing new hardship to a city already shaped by war and the dangers of the mountain landscape.
simp_chinese:
卡坦扎罗坐落在卡拉布里亚狭窄地带的丘陵上，介于第勒尼安海与爱奥尼亚海之间。高地位置使它成为天然据点，丝绸制造则帮助城市发展为商业中心。鲁福家族统治时，它控制着大片领土，作坊把周围乡村与山外市场连接起来。

法国与西班牙争夺意大利南部期间，法军于1528年围攻卡坦扎罗，却未能攻克。城市因坚守获得“壮丽而忠诚”的称号，连同帝国之鹰一同出现在城徽上。1783年，一连串地震袭击卡拉布里亚，重创卡坦扎罗，使这座经历战争的山城再次遭受灾难。

english: Cataraqui lies at the mouth of the Cataraqui River, where Lake Ontario meets the upper St Lawrence. In 1673 the French established a trading post and military fort there to control the fur trade with local Indigenous peoples. Initially called Fort Cataraqui and later Fort Frontenac, it became a focus for Indigenous and European settlement.
simp_chinese: 卡塔拉基位于卡塔拉基河河口，靠近安大略湖与圣劳伦斯河上游的交汇处。1673年，法国人在此建立贸易站和军事堡垒，以控制同当地原住民的毛皮贸易。堡垒最初称卡塔拉基堡，后来改称弗龙特纳克堡，并逐渐成为原住民和欧洲人聚居的中心。

english: Catarman lies on the northern coast of Samar, facing the waters around the San Bernardino Strait. Jesuit missionaries reached the wider region from their stations at Catubig and Palapag, and Catarman became one of their outlying communities. In 1649 a revolt led by Sumuroy spread from Palapag across northern Samar; Catarman's early church was burned amid the disturbances. After the Jesuits left the Philippines in 1768, Franciscans took responsibility for the missions on Samar.
simp_chinese: 卡塔曼位于萨马岛北岸，面向圣贝纳迪诺海峡周边水域。耶稣会传教士从卡图比格和帕拉帕格的据点进入这一地区，卡塔曼成为其下属社群之一。1649年，苏穆罗伊领导的起义从帕拉帕格扩展至萨马北部，卡塔曼早期教堂在动乱中被焚。1768年耶稣会离开菲律宾后，方济各会接管了萨马的传教区。

english: The Catatumbo rises in the mountains of northeastern Colombia and flows towards Lake Maracaibo. Its basin includes steep Andean slopes, forested lowlands and the waters that spread towards the lake. The Barí people inhabit this river country; their ancestral territory extended from the Maracaibo basin across the lower Perijá range towards the Cúcuta valley. The river provides a connection between the mountain interior and the broad lake.
simp_chinese: 卡塔通博河发源于哥伦比亚东北部山地，流向马拉开波湖。流域包括陡峭安第斯山坡、森林低地，以及通向湖泊的水道。巴里人居住在这一河流地区，其祖地从马拉开波湖盆地穿过佩里哈山脉低处，延向库库塔河谷。河流将山地内陆与宽阔湖泊相连。

english: The Catatumbo forests cover part of the country between the Serranía del Perijá and Lake Maracaibo. Rivers descend from the mountains through humid lowlands, joining the Catatumbo as it flows towards the lake. This is ancestral Barí territory, extending from the lake basin into the lower mountain ranges. Dense vegetation and a branching network of waterways shape the landscape between the Andes and the Maracaibo lowlands.
simp_chinese: 卡塔通博森林覆盖佩里哈山脉与马拉开波湖之间的一部分土地。河流从山地流经湿润低地，汇入流向湖泊的卡塔通博河。这里是巴里人的祖地，从湖盆延伸至较低山岭。茂密植被与分支水网塑造了安第斯山脉和马拉开波低地之间的景观。

english:
The Catawba called themselves yeh is-WAH h'reh, the people of the river. Their towns stood along the Catawba River in the Carolina Piedmont, where they traded deerskins for European muskets, knives, kettles and cloth. Their villages became a meeting point for traders from Virginia and Carolina. Communities displaced by war and disease joined them, contributing to a nation that brought together people from several neighbouring groups.

Epidemics and colonial encroachment took a heavy toll in the eighteenth century. After smallpox struck in 1759, the Catawba abandoned several towns and gathered at Twelve Mile Creek. Their leader Hagler negotiated with British officials at Pine Tree Hill in 1760, seeking protection for their remaining lands. The Treaty of Augusta in 1763 confirmed a reservation for the nation, though settlers continued to press upon its boundaries.
simp_chinese:
卡托巴人自称 yeh is-WAH h'reh，即“河流之民”。他们的城镇坐落在卡罗来纳皮德蒙特地区的卡托巴河畔，居民以鹿皮交换欧洲人的火枪、刀具、锅具和布匹。村庄成为来自弗吉尼亚和卡罗来纳的商人的交会之处。因战争与疾病流离失所的社群也来到这里，使卡托巴民族汇集了来自多个邻近族群的人们。

十八世纪，疫病和殖民者侵占土地使卡托巴人遭受沉重打击。1759年天花流行后，他们离开数座城镇，聚集到十二英里溪。1760年，首领哈格勒在松树丘与英国官员谈判，寻求保护剩余土地。1763年的奥古斯塔条约确认了他们的保留地，但移民仍不断向其边界逼近。

english: Catchacoma is a lake in the wooded country north of the larger waters that drain towards Lake Ontario. Its name has been explained as an Ojibwe expression for “big water.” It belongs to a chain of lakes that includes Beaver and Mississagua, where channels pass between rocky, tree-covered shores. These waters lie near the edge of the Canadian Shield, a landscape shaped by ancient rock and the passage of ice.
simp_chinese: 卡查科马湖位于林地之中，南面是流向安大略湖的较大水域。湖名被解释为奥吉布瓦语中的“大水”。它与比弗湖、米西索加湖等构成一组湖泊，水道从岩石和树木覆盖的湖岸之间穿过。这片水域靠近加拿大地盾边缘，地形由古老岩层和冰川活动塑造。

english:
Cateel lies on the wet eastern side of Mindanao in Davao Oriental, between the Pacific coast and forested mountains. Heavy rain feeds rivers and waterfalls; Aliwagwag descends through many tiers within a protected forest landscape. The surrounding watershed provided fish, timber, rattan and fertile garden land.

Mandaya and neighboring communities lived along the river valleys before Spanish contact, combining shifting cultivation, hunting, fishing and forest gathering. Spanish missionaries later established settlements and churches on the eastern coast, connecting Cateel with the colonial administration of Mindanao.

Houses clustered near river mouths and trails, while boats moved people and goods along the coast during calmer weather. Cateel’s identity comes from its rain-shaped terrain, forest rivers and the meeting of Indigenous upland society with coastal mission settlement. Rattan weaving and river fishing supported households. Coastal boats followed calmer monsoon windows. Mountain trails connected Mandaya settlements to the coast. Coconut, abaca and fish entered coastal barter. River crossings connected coastal villages. Forest products entered coastal trade.
simp_chinese:
卡蒂尔位于棉兰老东部达沃东方的湿润海岸，处在太平洋与森林山地之间。强降雨补给河流和瀑布，阿里瓦格瓦格瀑布在保护区内分多级落下。周围流域提供鱼、木材、藤和肥沃园地。

西班牙接触以前，曼达亚及邻近社群生活在河谷，兼营轮耕、狩猎、捕鱼和林地采集。西班牙传教士后来在东岸建立聚落和教堂，把卡蒂尔纳入棉兰老殖民行政。

住宅聚集在河口与小径附近，天气平静时船只沿海南运人员和货物。卡蒂尔身份来自多雨地形、森林河流，以及高地原住民社会同沿海传教聚落的相遇。藤编与河鱼供养家庭，山路连接高地曼达亚村落。沿岸船只在较平静的季风间隙航行，河流将木材和林产品带到海口。山地小径连接曼达亚聚落与海岸，河流和瀑布成为地方边界地标。椰子、蕉麻和鱼类进入沿海物物交换。渡口连接沿海村庄。林产品进入沿海贸易。

english:
Cateel Bay opens toward the eastern coast of Mindanao, where warm tropical water meets a densely wooded interior. The coast receives rain throughout the year, with especially heavy downpours in December and January, so streams descend from the uplands with unusual force. This abundant water sustains the forest and gives the baylands a close relationship with the rivers behind them.

Inland, Aliwagwag Falls forms a striking chain of 84 cascading tiers. Its separate drops range from about two to nearly thirty-four metres, and the full stairway of water reaches a height of roughly 340 metres. The falls occupy a largely undisturbed forest, while the river below runs through thirteen rapids. These features make the catchment more than a quiet backdrop to the coast: its water, rock and vegetation shape both the landscape and the routes followed by people in the valley.

Cateel is remembered as one of Mindanao's earliest municipalities and as a place associated with some of the region's earliest Spanish landings. Along this exposed shore, the forested interior and the history of settlement are joined by the recurring test of tropical weather.
simp_chinese:
卡特埃尔湾面向棉兰老岛东岸，温暖海水与林木茂密的内陆相接。这一带全年多雨，十二月至一月尤其容易落下暴雨，山间溪流因此常以强劲水量冲向下游。充沛水分滋养森林，也让海湾与身后河流形成密切联系。

内陆的阿利瓦格瓦格瀑布分为八十四级跌水，单级落差约二至三十四米，整道瀑布总高约三百四十米，犹如沿山坡铺开的水上阶梯。瀑布处在大片未受明显破坏的森林中，下方河流还分布着十三处急流。水、岩石和植被共同塑造了谷地景观，也影响了当地居民利用道路和通行的方式。

卡特埃尔被视为棉兰老岛最早建立的市镇之一，也与西班牙人早期在这一地区登陆的记忆相连。在这里，森林腹地与沿海聚落的联系始终伴随着雨季和风暴带来的考验。

english: The Catío are an Emberá people of the forested country between the Western Cordillera and the Atrato basin. Rivers cut through steep valleys and provide routes toward the Caribbean lowlands. Spanish expeditions entered the region in the sixteenth century, but Indigenous communities maintained their presence in the mountains and forests. The name Dabeiba is associated in local tradition with a figure revered by the Catío.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂奥人是居住在西部山脉与阿特拉托河流域之间森林地区的恩贝拉民族。河流切穿陡峭谷地，提供通往加勒比低地的道路。十六世纪西班牙远征队进入这一地区，但原住民社群继续居住在山林中。地方传统将达贝瓦这一名称与卡蒂奥人敬重的人物联系起来。

english:
Catoctin Mountain forms the eastern edge of the Blue Ridge, running southwest from near Emmitsburg across the Potomac and into Virginia. Its name probably comes from the Kittoctons, an Indigenous people who lived between the mountain and the river. The long wooded ridge stands above the valleys to its west.

European settlers, including German immigrants, established farmsteads in the valleys around the mountain. Lord Baltimore had encouraged settlement by offering land and a three-year exemption from taxes. Iron ore was found in the 1770s, and a furnace was built to work it. Timber cutting consumed much of the woodland by the end of the eighteenth century; farmers also grew maize for distilling whiskey. The mountain's resources thus supported both farming and the emerging iron industry.
simp_chinese:
卡托克廷山构成蓝岭山脉的东缘，从埃米茨堡附近向西南延伸，越过波托马克河进入弗吉尼亚。山名可能来自基托克顿人，他们曾生活在山脉与河流之间。绵长的森林山脊耸立在西侧的谷地之上。

包括德国移民在内的欧洲定居者在山地周围的谷地建立农场。巴尔的摩勋爵曾以土地和三年免税期吸引移民。1770年代当地发现铁矿，并建起了熔炉。到十八世纪末，伐木已耗尽大片林地；农民也种植玉米，用来蒸馏威士忌。山地的资源因而既供养农业，也支持新兴的炼铁业。

english:
Cattaraugus lies in the wooded country of the Cattaraugus Creek, which flows west into Lake Erie. The region was associated with the Wenro, an Iroquoian-speaking people of the eastern Great Lakes. In the late 1630s warfare and the loss of protection from their Neutral allies drove many Wenro to seek refuge among the Wendat to the north.

The area later formed part of Seneca country. In 1797 the Seneca signed an agreement at Big Tree that transferred most of their remaining lands in western New York while reserving several smaller tracts. Among them were lands at Cattaraugus, described in the agreement by reference to the creek and the shore of Lake Erie. Subsequent exchanges altered the boundaries of the reserved land.
simp_chinese:
卡塔劳格斯位于森林覆盖的卡塔劳格斯溪流域，溪水向西注入伊利湖。这片地区与五大湖东部的易洛魁语族群温罗人有关。十七世纪三十年代末，战争以及中立族盟友撤回保护，迫使许多温罗人向北方的温达特人寻求庇护。

此地后来成为塞内卡领土的一部分。1797年，塞内卡人在大树镇签订协议，转让他们在纽约西部剩余的大部分土地，同时保留若干较小地块。其中包括卡塔劳格斯的土地，协议以溪流与伊利湖岸为参照描述其范围。后来的土地交换改变了保留地的边界。

english:
Catucto is associated with Battle Harbour, a sheltered harbour among the islands off southern Labrador. The surrounding coast was visited by Inuit hunters and traders, as well as fishing crews seeking cod in the rich waters of the Labrador Sea. From the islands, boats could reach the fishing grounds while finding shelter from the open Atlantic.

By the early 1770s, John Slade and Company had established a mercantile station at Battle Harbour. Its workers caught and cured cod, and the firm supplied crews who came north from Newfoundland to fish along the coast. Inuit also traded with the merchants: a Slade company record lists John Oglukok at Battle Harbour in 1798. The harbour grew into a centre for the seasonal Labrador fishery and the exchange of coastal goods.
simp_chinese:
卡图克托与巴特尔港相对应，港湾位于拉布拉多南部近岸岛屿之间，较能躲避外海风浪。因纽特猎人和商人来到这片海岸，渔民也在拉布拉多海盛产鳕鱼的水域作业。船只从岛屿出发可以抵达渔场，返回时则能在港内避开大西洋风浪。

到十八世纪七十年代初，约翰·斯莱德公司已在巴特尔港设立商站。雇工捕捞、腌制鳕鱼，公司还为从纽芬兰北上沿岸捕鱼的船队提供物资。因纽特人也与商人交易：1798年的斯莱德公司记录中便列有来到巴特尔港的约翰·奥格卢科克。港湾逐渐成为拉布拉多季节渔业和沿海货物交换的中心。

english: The forests west of the Cauca valley climb the slopes of Colombia’s Western Cordillera. Moist air from the Pacific brings heavy rainfall, feeding rivers that cut through steep valleys toward the coast and the Cauca. Indigenous communities inhabited these mountains before Spanish expansion into the valley in the sixteenth century. Forested ridges separated the colonial settlements from the humid river country of the Pacific lowlands.
simp_chinese: 考卡河谷以西的森林攀上哥伦比亚西部山脉的坡地。来自太平洋的湿润气流带来丰沛降雨，滋养穿过陡峭谷地、流向海岸与考卡河的河流。十六世纪西班牙人扩展进入河谷之前，原住民社群已居住在这些山地。森林山脊将殖民聚落与太平洋低地湿润的河流地区分开。

english:
Cauit Point lies within the island-divided Samar Sea, between Samar, Leyte, Masbate and southern Luzon. Its passages connect the Philippine Sea, Leyte Gulf and the Visayan and Sibuyan seas. Biliran, Almagro, Maripipi, Daram and other islands break the surface, creating sheltered coves and narrow channels with strong currents.

Fishing communities used reefs and shorelines for food, salt and exchange. The Masbate and Ticao passages connected the Samar Sea with the Sibuyan Sea, while the wider water offered access to the Visayan Sea. Channels between islands provided sheltered routes, but currents and changing weather forced crews to wait or divert. Boats carried rice, fish, cloth and forest products across short inter-island routes, while larger seafarers passed through the San Bernardino and San Juanico straits. Typhoons and sudden squalls made seasonal knowledge essential. Settlements clustered at secure landings and moved among fishing grounds and market villages.

Local boatmen transmitted landing, reef and current knowledge across generations. Spanish colonization introduced towns, missions and new shipping networks after the sixteenth century, especially through Leyte and Samar, but canoe and coastal boat travel remained the practical link between islands. Cauit Point was therefore part of a dense maritime world built from short crossings, reefs and local pilotage rather than one broad open corridor.
simp_chinese:
考伊特角位于岛屿分割的萨马海，周围是萨马、莱特、马斯巴特和吕宋南部。附近水道连接菲律宾海、莱特湾、米沙鄢海与锡布延海。比里兰、阿尔马格罗、马里皮皮、达拉姆等岛屿露出海面，形成受遮蔽小湾和带强洋流的狭窄水道。

渔村利用礁区与岸线取得食物、盐和交换品。马斯巴特海峡和蒂考海峡把萨马海通到锡布延海，更宽阔的水面还可通往米沙鄢海。岛间水道提供受遮蔽航路，但洋流和天气变化迫使船员等待或改道。船只沿短途岛际路线运送稻米、鱼、布匹与林产，较大海船则经过圣贝纳迪诺和圣胡安尼科海峡。台风与突发飑风使季节知识至关重要，聚落集中在安全登陆点，并随渔场和市场移动。

地方船夫把登陆点、礁区和洋流知识世代相传。十六世纪以后，西班牙殖民统治尤其通过莱特和萨马带来城镇、传教站和新的航运网络，但独木舟与沿岸船仍是岛间实际联系。考伊特角因此属于由短途横渡、珊瑚礁和地方领航构成的密集海上世界，而非单一宽阔走廊。

english:
Cauitaome was the name of one band of the Chisos, a group of the Big Bend country that was also called Taquitatome. Spanish usage later stretched the name Chiso to cover at least six closely associated bands, and these groups were linked with the Concho-speaking peoples of northeastern Chihuahua and northwestern Coahuila. The name therefore points to a group of people rather than to any particular settlement.

Like other Chisos groups, the band was nomadic, living by hunting and gathering and perhaps by limited farming. Their language belonged to the Uto-Aztecan family, the same family that includes Aztec and Hopi. Its name survived in Spanish usage, so Cauitaome refers to these people rather than to a fixed town.
simp_chinese:
考伊陶梅是大弯地区奇索斯人中一个群体的名称，也写作塔基塔托梅。西班牙人后来把奇索这一名称扩展到至少六个紧密相关的群体，这些群体与奇瓦瓦州东北部和科阿韦拉州西北部讲孔乔语的原住民有关。因此，这一名称指的是一群人，而不是某个具体聚落。

作为一个群体，考伊陶梅人与其他奇索群体一样是流动的狩猎采集者，可能也进行有限的农业生产。他们的语言属于犹他-阿兹特克语系，该语系还包括阿兹特克语和霍皮语。这一名称在西班牙人的用法中保留下来，因此“考伊陶梅”指的是这些人，而非某个固定的城镇。

english:
Cauouatstacau is a north-bank tributary of the Eastmain River in the boreal interior of western Quebec. It drains a country of lakes, muskeg, spruce forest and low rocky ridges, joining the main river near the middle of its course before the Eastmain turns toward James Bay. Its waters shared the seasonal rhythm of freeze-up, spring flood and open-water travel that governed life across Eeyou Istchee.

Cree families used the river corridor for fishing, hunting and access to inland camps. Canoes carried people and goods in summer; snowshoes and sledges crossed frozen lakes and portages in winter. Resources were shared through kinship, marriage and stewardship of hunting territories rather than concentrated in permanent villages. The river was one path within a much larger network of lakes and tracks.

From the 1670s Hudson’s Bay Company traders reached the Eastmain mouth, and a company post was established there in 1723–24. Metal goods, cloth, firearms and tobacco entered local exchange, while beaver pelts and other furs travelled toward James Bay. The new trade strengthened certain routes and intermediaries, but Cree families continued to move through the Cauouatstacau country according to seasons, water and game.
simp_chinese:
考瓦茨塔考河是魁北克西部寒温带内陆伊斯特梅恩河的一条北岸支流。它流经湖泊、泥炭沼泽、云杉林和低矮岩脊，在河流中段汇入主河道；此后伊斯特梅恩河继续向西流入詹姆斯湾。封冻、春汛与通航季节的循环，也支配着整个伊尤伊奇地域的生活。

克里人家庭利用河谷捕鱼、狩猎并前往内陆营地。夏季以独木舟载人和运货，冬季则穿雪鞋、拖雪橇越过冰湖与陆运道。资源通过亲缘、婚姻和对狩猎地域的守护关系流通，并未集中在永久村庄。这条河只是由湖泊、小径和营地点构成的大网络中的一条通道，营地位置也会随猎物和水情而改变。

1670年代起，哈得孙湾公司商人抵达伊斯特梅恩河口，1723年至1724年间又在那里设立商站。金属器、布匹、火器和烟草进入地方交换，河狸皮及其他毛皮则运往詹姆斯湾。贸易加强了一些路线和中间人的地位，但克里家庭仍依季节、水源和猎物，在考瓦茨塔考河流域往来。

english: Caupolican lies in the mountain country northeast of Lake Titicaca, where the Apolobamba ranges descend towards the Amazon. The Kallawaya inhabited these high valleys before the Inca conquest, maintaining a distinctive tradition of healing and knowledge of plants. Their country spans cold mountain heights and warmer eastern slopes, linking communities across the dramatic change in altitude.
simp_chinese: 考波利坎位于的的喀喀湖东北方的山地，阿波洛班巴山脉从这里向亚马孙下降。印加征服之前，卡利亚瓦亚人已居住在高山河谷，保持独特的疗愈和植物知识传统。他们的土地跨越寒冷山岭与温暖东坡，联系海拔急剧变化地区的社群。

english:
Cauquenes lies among the rivers and hills of the Maule country in central Chile. Before the Spanish foundation, indigenous communities lived in the district, which colonial sources associated with the Promaucaes. Vineyards, wheat fields and livestock later became important features of the surrounding countryside.

In 1742 Governor José Antonio Manso de Velasco founded the villa of Nuestra Señora de las Mercedes de Manso del Tutuvén between the Tutuvén and Cauquenes rivers. The land was donated by the local chief Ascencio Galdámez and his wife Micaela de Araya. By 1745 the new settlement had sixteen houses, a church and a square marked out for royal justice. It acquired a town council, and in 1826 it received the name and title of the city of Cauquenes.
simp_chinese:
考克内斯位于智利中部马乌莱地区的河流和丘陵之间。西班牙人建城之前，原住民社群居住在这一地区，殖民文献将其与普罗毛考人联系起来。葡萄园、麦田和牲畜后来成为周围乡村的重要景象。

1742年，总督何塞·安东尼奥·曼索·德贝拉斯科在图图文河与考克内斯河之间建立图图文圣母仁慈镇。当地首领阿森西奥·加尔达梅斯和妻子米卡埃拉·德阿拉亚捐献了土地。到1745年，新聚落已有十六座房屋和一座教堂，并划出广场作为施行王室司法的场所。镇上也设立了市政议会，1826年正式获得考克内斯的名字和城市称号。

english:
The Cauracahuin were a Huilliche people of the plains around Osorno, south of the Bueno River. Their country lay among rivers and forests between the coastal ranges and the Andes. The Spanish founded Osorno in the sixteenth century, but the town was abandoned after the great Mapuche uprising at the end of that century, leaving its former site within Huilliche territory.

Late in the eighteenth century, renewed Spanish expansion brought conflict and negotiation. Following a Huilliche uprising in 1792 and its suppression, colonial officials and indigenous leaders met at the long abandoned stone ruins of Osorno in September 1793 for the Parliament of Las Canoas. The meeting marked a new stage in Spanish attempts to establish authority and communications through the southern lands.
simp_chinese:
考拉卡温人是居住在布埃诺河以南、奥索尔诺平原一带的维利切人。他们的土地位于海岸山脉与安第斯山脉之间，河流和森林遍布。西班牙人于十六世纪建立奥索尔诺，但世纪末马普切人大起义后城镇被放弃，旧址重归维利切领地。

十八世纪末，西班牙人再度扩张，带来了冲突与谈判。1792年维利切人起义及其后遭到镇压之后，殖民官员和原住民领袖于1793年9月在奥索尔诺废墟召开拉斯卡诺阿斯议会。这次会议标志着西班牙试图在南方土地建立权威和交通的新阶段。

english: Cauromá is an Indigenous community name in the mountain country near Supía, west of the Cauca River. The region’s valleys and slopes were inhabited before Spanish expeditions entered the middle Cauca in the sixteenth century. Indigenous communities cultivated crops and worked gold from the rivers, while the mountains linked the Cauca valley with the western forests. Colonial settlement introduced new claims to land and labour throughout the region.
simp_chinese: 考罗马是考卡河以西苏皮亚附近山地的原住民社群名称。十六世纪西班牙远征队进入考卡河中游之前，居民已生活在这里的谷地和坡地。原住民社群种植作物并从河流中获取黄金，山地将考卡河谷与西部森林连接起来。殖民定居在整个地区引入了对土地和劳力的新要求。

english:
Causapscal lies where the Matapédia and Causapscal rivers meet in the valley of the Gaspé interior. The surrounding landscape combines forested hills, salmon rivers and narrow corridors through the Appalachian uplands. The Mi'kmaq name refers to a rocky bed, swift water or stony point, tied directly to the river rather than to a later town.

Indigenous families travelled the Matapédia corridor to reach the Restigouche estuary, the St Lawrence and the Bay of Chaleur. Fishing, hunting and canoe routes connected several watersheds. Acadian and French traders later entered the route, exchanging metal goods, cloth and food with Mi'kmaq communities.

The river junction was the fixed point of this country. Causapscal's identity belongs to an Indigenous route across the wooded interior. Furs, fish and forest materials moved along the river junction, where travelers changed routes before crossing the highlands. Salmon, eels and forest game supported camps near the confluence, where travellers could shelter before entering the steep valley. Moose, beaver and salmon supplied food and exchange goods, and canoe routes connected the St Lawrence and Restigouche drainages.
simp_chinese:
科萨普斯卡尔位于加斯佩内地马塔佩迪亚河与科萨普斯卡尔河汇合处。周围是森林丘陵、鲑鱼河以及穿越阿巴拉契亚高地的狭窄通道。米克马克语地名指多石河床、急流或石岬，直接描述河流而非后来的城镇。

原住民家庭沿马塔佩迪亚走廊前往雷斯蒂古什河口、圣劳伦斯河和沙勒尔湾。捕鱼、狩猎和独木舟路线把数个流域连接起来。阿卡迪亚和法国商人后来进入路线，用金属、布匹和粮食同米克马克社群交换。

两河汇口是这片土地上固定的节点。科萨普斯卡尔的身份属于穿越森林内地的原住民道路。毛皮、鱼类和林材经两河汇口流通，旅人在进入高地以前于此转换路线。鲑鱼、鳗鱼和林中猎物维持汇口附近的营地，旅人可在进入陡谷前避居。驼鹿、海狸和鲑鱼提供食物与交换品，独木舟路线连接圣劳伦斯和雷斯蒂古什水系。

english: The Caux were an Indigenous people living near Galveston Bay on the upper Texas coast, most likely a band of the Akokisa, Atakapan speakers who ranged around the bay and between the Trinity and Sabine rivers. François Simars de Bellisle, a Frenchman, was held by the Caux for several months in 1719–1720, and his account is one of the earliest descriptions of people on this coast. In 1756–1757 Spanish missionaries built the mission of Nuestra Señora de la Luz near the mouth of the Trinity for the Akokisa and Bidai, bringing Spanish institutions into their homeland. The mission closed in 1772.
simp_chinese: 考克斯人是居住在加尔维斯顿湾附近得克萨斯北部海岸的原住民，很可能是阿科基萨人的一支；阿科基萨人讲阿塔卡帕语，活动于海湾一带及特里尼蒂河与萨宾河之间。1719至1720年，法国人弗朗索瓦·西马尔·德·贝利勒被考克斯人扣留数月，他的记述是有关这一海岸居民的早期资料之一。1756至1757年，西班牙传教士在特里尼蒂河口附近为阿科基萨人与比代人建立光明圣母传教区，把殖民制度带到他们的故土。传教区于1772年关闭。

english: Cavalese lies in the Fiemme Valley beside the Gambis brook. The village developed in the twelfth century, when mills, sawmills and smiths working copper made use of the stream. The valley was ruled by the prince-bishops of Trent, but its inhabitants enjoyed broad autonomy through the community of Fiemme. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries bishops and nobles came to Cavalese for recreation and contributed to its growth; the bishops' palace later became the home of the valley community.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦莱塞位于菲耶梅谷的甘比斯溪畔。村庄在十二世纪发展起来，磨坊、锯木厂和加工铜料的铁匠利用溪水经营作坊。谷地由特伦托采邑主教统治，但居民通过菲耶梅共同体享有广泛自治。十六和十七世纪，主教与贵族来到卡瓦莱塞休憩，促进了村庄发展；主教宫殿后来成为谷地共同体的驻地。

english:
Cavan grew up in a hollow beneath the O'Reilly stronghold at Tullymongan, in the Gaelic lordship of East Bréifne. A Franciscan friary, traditionally founded by Giolla Íosa O'Reilly around 1300, became a focus of the settlement and a burial place for the ruling family. Its market made the town a centre for the surrounding country, though warfare repeatedly brought destruction to its streets and religious house.

English forces burned the friary and town in 1468. In the late sixteenth century the friary served as a fortified position during the fighting in Ulster, and the town was attacked again in 1595. The plantation of the early seventeenth century brought English and Scottish settlers; in 1610 James I granted Cavan a charter of incorporation, giving the borough a framework for its markets and government. The friars returned in 1616, continuing their work despite the loss of their medieval house.
simp_chinese:
卡文兴起于塔利蒙甘山下的低地，山上是东布雷夫讷盖尔领主奥赖利家族的据点。相传吉拉·伊萨·奥赖利于1300年前后在此创建方济各会修院；修院成为聚落的中心，也供统治家族安葬。市集使小镇成为周边乡村的中心，但战事屡次给街道与修院带来毁坏。

1468年，英军焚毁小镇与修院。十六世纪末阿尔斯特战事期间，修院曾被用作设防据点，1595年小镇再次遭袭。十七世纪初的殖民安置带来英格兰和苏格兰移民；1610年詹姆斯一世授予卡文自治特许状，为市集和城镇管理确立制度。修士于1616年返回，即使失去了中世纪修院，仍继续在当地活动。

english: Cawachagamite, a Cree name meaning “clear-water lake,” lies northwest of Lake Mistassini amid the forests of the Eastmain watershed. Its irregular shores and many bays feed a chain of lakes leading towards the Eastmain River. Around 1790 the Hudson's Bay Company established the Neoskweskau post near Lake de la Marée, and Cawachagamite became a stage on a route from the southeast. Cree families travelled through this lake country to trade furs and make use of its waterways.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦查加米特的克里语名称意为“清水湖”，位于米斯塔西尼湖西北、伊斯特梅恩河流域的森林中。湖岸曲折，众多水湾通向一串湖泊，最终汇入伊斯特梅恩河。约1790年，哈得孙湾公司在拉马雷湖附近建立内奥斯奎斯考商站，卡瓦查加米特成为东南方向通往商站的路线上的一站。克里家庭穿行于湖区，利用水道并进行毛皮贸易。

english: Cawassiemica lies near the great widening of the upper Ottawa River known as Grand Lac Victoria. Algonquin families have long gathered at Kitcisakik on its eastern shore, where the river opens into the lake. The surrounding forest and waterways form part of a much larger inland country connected to the lower Ottawa valley.
simp_chinese: 卡瓦西米卡靠近渥太华河上游的一处宽阔水域，即维多利亚大湖。阿尔冈昆家庭长久以来在东岸的基齐萨基克聚会，河流在这里扩展成湖。周围的森林与水道属于广阔的内陆地区，并与渥太华河下游河谷相连。

english: Caxa lies in the Talisi country of central Alabama, a region of forested plains and river valleys in the south-eastern woodlands of North America. From about 1000 to 1600, Mississippian farming communities lived along the rivers here, growing maize and building earthen mounds. Moundville, a major centre farther upriver, shows links to a wider network of ceremonial objects and ideas. Spanish expeditions reached the region in the sixteenth century, and English and French traders later competed for trade with the Creek towns. After Alabama became a state in 1819, cotton plantations expanded on land worked by enslaved African Americans. The Indian Removal Act of 1830 preceded the forced removal of Creek and other Indigenous communities from their homelands.
simp_chinese: 卡哈位于北美洲东南部林地中的阿拉巴马中部塔利西地区，这里是林地平原与河谷交织的地带。大约公元1000年至1600年，密西西比农业社群沿河定居，种植玉米并修筑土丘。上游的蒙德维尔是重要的区域中心，其遗存显示与更广泛的礼仪器物和观念网络相联系。十六世纪，西班牙远征队进入该地区，后来英法商人也与克里克人的城镇竞争贸易。1819年阿拉巴马成为美国一州后，依赖被奴役非裔劳动的棉花种植园迅速扩张。1830年印第安人迁移法通过，克里克人等原住民社群随后被迫离开家园。

english:
Caxangá lies beside the Capibaribe River, upstream from Recife on the northeastern Brazilian coast. The river winds through the humid coastal plain before reaching the Atlantic, and its banks supported settlements beyond the port. In colonial Pernambuco, the valley formed part of a landscape of plantations and sugar mills, tied to the growing settlement at the mouth of the Capibaribe.

The later city of Recife lies here.
simp_chinese:
卡尚加位于卡皮巴里贝河畔，在巴西东北海岸累西腓的上游。河流蜿蜒穿过湿润的沿海平原，最终注入大西洋，河岸上分布着港口以外的聚落。殖民时期的伯南布哥，这条河谷是种植园与制糖厂遍布的地区之一，并与卡皮巴里贝河口不断成长的聚落相联系。

后来的累西腓即位于此地。

english:
Caxitlán stood beside the Armería River near the Pacific coast of western Mexico. It was an important Indigenous centre of Coliman before the Spanish conquest. Its riverside location brought the settlement close to the coast, in the warm lowlands below the mountains of Colima.

In 1523 Spanish conquerors founded the first Villa de Colima at Caxitlán and established a municipal council, with officers responsible for governing the new settlement in the name of the crown. The settlement was one of the earliest Spanish foundations in western New Spain. The hot and humid conditions at the low-lying site proved difficult, and in 1527 the villa was moved inland. Caxitlán nevertheless remained a landmark in the early history of Spanish expansion along the Pacific coast.
simp_chinese:
卡希特兰位于墨西哥西部太平洋海岸附近的阿尔梅里亚河畔，是西班牙征服前科利曼的重要原住民中心。河畔聚落接近海岸，坐落在科利马群山下方温暖的低地。

1523年，西班牙征服者在卡希特兰建立最初的科利马镇，并设立市政议会，由官员代表王室管理新聚落。这是新西班牙西部最早的西班牙人定居点之一。低洼地点的条件困难，1527年城镇迁往内陆。然而，卡希特兰仍是西班牙人沿太平洋海岸早期扩张的重要历史地点。

english: Caxiuanã Bay extends into the forested country between the Xingu and the waters of the lower Amazon estuary. Its dark waters are bordered by flooded forest, while higher ground supports dense tropical woodland. Channels connect the bay with neighbouring rivers, making it part of the intricate network of waterways that crosses the eastern Amazon.
simp_chinese: 卡希瓦纳湾伸入欣古河与下亚马孙河口水域之间的森林地区。深色水域周围是淹水森林，较高的土地上则生长着茂密热带林。水道将海湾与邻近河流连接起来，使其成为横贯东亚马孙的复杂水网的一部分。

english: C'Axud was a district of Armenian Cilicia in the hilly country along the middle Seyhan. Near its boundary with Bardzraberd stood Akner monastery, in a landscape of streams below the fortified heights. Akner was a centre of Armenian learning and manuscript illumination, its name recalling the springs and flowing water around it. The monastery linked the communities of these mountain districts to the religious and literary life of the Armenian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 贾胡德是奇里乞亚亚美尼亚的一处地区，位于塞伊汉河中游的丘陵地带。靠近巴尔兹拉贝尔德边界处有阿克纳修道院，四周溪流环绕，上方是设防的高地。阿克纳是亚美尼亚学术与手抄本彩饰的中心，其名字使人想起附近的泉水和溪流。修道院将山地各社区与亚美尼亚王国的宗教和文学生活联系起来。

english: The Cay forest covers wet mountain slopes near the Aysén fjord in western Patagonia. The volcanic mountains and valleys receive abundant rain from the Pacific, supporting dense evergreen woodland. Rivers descend through the forest towards the fjord and its sheltered channels. The Cay volcano rises in this rugged country, where glacially shaped valleys bring the inland Andes close to the sea.
simp_chinese: 凯森林覆盖巴塔哥尼亚西部艾森峡湾附近的湿润山坡。火山山地与河谷接收来自太平洋的丰沛降雨，孕育茂密常绿林。河流穿过森林流向峡湾及受庇护的水道。凯火山耸立在这片崎岖地带，冰川塑造的谷地使内陆安第斯山脉与海洋相距不远。

sources.title: Plan Regional de Ordenamiento Territorial de Aysen.pdf

english: Cay Sal Bank is a broad shallow platform between Florida, Cuba and the Great Bahama Bank. The Florida Straits separate it from Florida, the Nicholas Channel from Cuba, and the Santaren Channel from the larger Bahamian bank. Small cays rise around its margins, while much of the interior lies beneath the sea. Its shallow water stands in sharp contrast to the deeper channels surrounding it.
simp_chinese: 萨尔礁浅滩是佛罗里达、古巴和大巴哈马浅滩之间一片宽阔的浅水台地。佛罗里达海峡将它与佛罗里达隔开，尼古拉斯海峡将它与古巴隔开，圣塔伦海峡则位于它与更大的巴哈马浅滩之间。小岛散布在台地边缘，内部大部分处于水下；浅水与周围较深的海峡形成鲜明对比。

english:
Cayacoa is a name associated with a Taíno leader of Higüey, the eastern part of Hispaniola. The chiefdom extended over a wide country of coastal plains and river valleys, including the region of the Higuamo River. Its communities were governed by local leaders before the Spanish conquest, and Cayacoa’s name survives in accounts of that Indigenous political landscape.

The later city of Santo Domingo lies here.
simp_chinese:
卡亚科阿是与伊斯帕尼奥拉岛东部伊圭地区一位泰诺首领相关的名称。伊圭酋邦覆盖广阔的沿海平原与河谷，包括伊瓜莫河地区。西班牙征服之前，这里的社群由地方首领治理；卡亚科阿之名保存在有关原住民政治地域的记载中。

后来的圣多明各即位于此地。

english: Cayaguayo is an Indigenous name recorded for a district on the northern coast of Cuba. It appears in accounts of the island’s regions at the time of the Spanish conquest, alongside neighboring names such as Maniabón and Sagua. Its survival in early writings preserves a trace of the named places and communities that existed before Spanish rule reshaped the island. The same name was also used for a hill in Havana.
simp_chinese: 卡亚瓜约是古巴北部海岸一个地区的原住民名称。有关西班牙征服时期岛屿各地区的记载，将它与马尼亚翁、萨瓜等邻近名称一同列出。这个名称在早期文献中的保存，留下了西班牙统治改变岛屿之前的地名与社群的痕迹。哈瓦那的一座山丘也使用过同一名称。

english: The southern Cayapó were Indigenous Jê-speaking peoples of the grasslands and wooded river valleys of southern Goiás and the Triângulo Mineiro. Colonial records describe conflicts with Portuguese expeditions and settlements during the eighteenth century, as mining routes and cattle raising expanded into their lands. Their history is also linked by researchers to the ancestors of the Panará of the southern Amazon.
simp_chinese: 南卡亚波人是戈亚斯南部和米纳斯三角地区草原与森林河谷中的热语原住民族。十八世纪，采矿道路和牧场扩展到他们的土地，殖民文献记载了他们与葡萄牙远征队及聚落的冲突。研究者也将他们的历史与亚马孙南部帕纳拉人的祖先联系起来。

english: Cayas was the name of an Indigenous chiefdom encountered by the Hernando de Soto expedition in the Arkansas River country. Its people lived along a river that the Spaniards called the River of Cayas, amid a landscape of wooded uplands and fertile bottomlands. The expedition passed through the region in 1541 while looking for food and a route through the interior. Farther downstream it spent the following winter at Autiamque.
simp_chinese: 卡亚斯是埃尔南多·德索托远征队在阿肯色河地区遇到的一个原住民酋邦。居民生活在西班牙人称为卡亚斯河的水道沿岸，周围有林木覆盖的高地与肥沃低地。1541年，远征队寻找食物和穿越内陆的道路时经过这一地区，随后在下游的奥蒂安克过冬。

english:
The Caicos Islands lie at the southeastern end of the Lucayan archipelago, surrounded by shallow banks and reefs. Lucayan communities occupied the islands before Spanish raids carried people away as enslaved laborers in the early sixteenth century. Their settlements left traces on Middle Caicos and other islands.

Bermudians later came to the neighboring Turks Islands to gather salt from natural ponds. During the eighteenth century these islands became part of a contested maritime world in which salt, ships and imperial rivalries brought visitors from across the Atlantic. After the American Revolutionary War, loyalists received land in the Caicos and attempted to establish plantations, bringing enslaved Africans with them. These agricultural ventures struggled in the dry conditions of the islands and enjoyed little lasting success.
simp_chinese:
凯科斯群岛位于卢卡扬群岛东南端，四周是浅滩与礁石。十六世纪初西班牙人将岛民掳走充当奴工之前，卢卡扬社群曾在这里生活，他们在中凯科斯及其他岛屿留下了聚落遗迹。

后来百慕大人来到邻近的特克斯群岛，从天然盐池采盐。十八世纪，盐业、船舶与帝国竞争将这些岛屿卷入大西洋海上活动。美国独立战争后，保皇派在凯科斯获得土地，试图建立种植园，并带来了被奴役的非洲人。干燥的岛屿环境使这些农业尝试困难重重，成果有限。

english:
Cayenne occupies part of a former island at the mouth of the Cayenne River, where the water meets the Atlantic coast of Guiana. Spanish explorers visited the surrounding coast but judged the heat too severe for settlement. France made the first attempt in 1604, only for the Portuguese to destroy the new establishment while asserting their territorial claim. Colonists returned in 1643 and laid out Cayenne, but attacks by Indigenous inhabitants forced them to withdraw once more. France finally established a settlement that endured in 1664.

The early town remained vulnerable to imperial rivalry. Over the following decade it passed among French, Dutch and English hands before returning to France. The nearby sea and river gave the place strategic value, but heat, local resistance and competition made control uncertain. Cayenne's name marks a contested coastal foothold whose importance grew from its maritime access.
simp_chinese:
卡宴位于卡宴河河口的一座旧岛上，河水在这里汇入圭亚那的大西洋海岸。西班牙探险者曾到过附近，却认为当地酷热难耐，没有建立定居点。1604年的法国殖民尝试很快被葡萄牙人摧毁，后者以此维护自己的领土主张。法国殖民者1643年返回并建立卡宴，但原住居民的袭击又迫使他们撤离。直到1664年，法国才建立较持久的聚落。

早期城镇始终容易受到列强争夺。此后十余年间，它先后落入法国、荷兰和英国手中，最终归还法国。河海相接的位置赋予它战略价值，炎热气候、当地抵抗和欧洲竞争却使统治一直不稳。对周边地区而言，卡宴之名代表一处多次易手的沿海立足点，它的重要性来自海上通道。

english:
Cayguani was an Indigenous territory on Hispaniola described by Bartolomé de las Casas as adjoining Xaragua. The name belongs to the geography of the island before Spanish conquest, when communities under their own leaders inhabited the valleys and coastal country of the west. Its survival in early accounts preserves one of the many Taíno place names recorded as colonial rule transformed the island.

The later city of Neiba lies here.
simp_chinese:
凯瓜尼是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的原住民地域，巴托洛梅·德拉斯卡萨斯称其毗邻哈拉瓜。这个名称属于西班牙征服之前的岛屿地理；当时由各自首领领导的社群居住在西部河谷与海岸地区。名称在早期记载中留存，是殖民统治改变岛屿时被记录的众多泰诺地名之一。

后来的内巴即位于此地。

english: The Cayubaba are an Indigenous people of the Mamoré lowlands in the Llanos de Moxos. Their country lies among rivers, lakes and seasonally flooded savannas. In 1704 the Jesuit Antonio Garriga founded the mission of Exaltación on the Mamoré for the Cayubaba. The mission brought people together under Spanish colonial authority and became an enduring centre of Cayubaba life.
simp_chinese: 卡尤巴巴人是莫霍斯平原马莫雷河低地的原住民族，生活在河流、湖泊与季节性受淹的稀树草原之间。1704年，耶稣会士安东尼奥·加里加在马莫雷河畔为卡尤巴巴人建立了埃克萨尔塔西翁传教站。传教站将人们集中在西班牙殖民统治之下，并成为卡尤巴巴人长期生活的重要中心。

english:
The Cayuvava people inhabit the plains of the Mamoré basin, a country of rivers, savannas and seasonal floods. Their language is distinct from those of many neighbouring peoples. Jesuit missionaries founded the mission of Exaltación among the Cayuvava at the beginning of the eighteenth century. The Mamoré provided a water route through the lowlands, linking the mission settlements of Moxos to the wider river system.

The later city of Trinidad lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
卡尤瓦瓦人生活在马莫雷河流域的平原上，这片土地河流、稀树草原与季节性洪水交错。他们的语言不同于许多邻族的语言。十八世纪初，耶稣会士在卡尤瓦瓦人中建立埃克萨尔塔西翁传教聚落。马莫雷河为低地提供水路，将莫霍斯的传教聚落与更广阔的河流系统连接起来。

后来的特立尼达位于此地附近。

english:
Cazombo lies on the eastern bank of the Zambezi in eastern Angola, at one of the river's many crossing points on its long course from the highlands toward the Atlantic. The Zambezi flows through open woodland here, and the banks offered fish, water and fertile soil for gardens. The land rises gently away from the river into miombo woodland, where villages cleared fields and hunted game.

Lunda and Lovale peoples lived along this stretch of the river and in the country behind it. Chiefs controlled the river crossings and the paths that carried ivory, wax, cloth and captives toward the western trade. Their authority rested on lineage, ritual and the control of the river routes.
simp_chinese:
卡宗博位于安哥拉东部赞比西河东岸，这条大河从高地向大西洋流淌，途中有许多渡口，这里便是其中之一。赞比西河穿过开阔的林地，河岸提供鱼类、饮水和适于园圃的沃土。远离河岸，土地缓缓抬升为密林，村落在林中开垦田地、狩猎野兽。

隆达与洛瓦莱人群沿河及河后的内陆而居。首领掌控渡口和小径，这些小径运送象牙、蜡、布匹和俘虏，流向西方贸易。其权威依靠宗族、仪式以及对河道路线的控制。

english: Cazorla lies beneath the forested mountains of eastern Andalusia, guarded by the castle of La Yedra. In the thirteenth century the surrounding lands became an ecclesiastical lordship of the archbishops of Toledo, known as the Adelantamiento of Cazorla. During the Castilian civil war the town remained loyal to Peter I while the archbishop supported his rival. Its castle was repaired and given a new keep in the early fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 卡索拉坐落在安达卢西亚东部林木覆盖的山麓，由拉耶德拉城堡守护。13世纪，周边土地成为托莱多总主教的教会领地，称为卡索拉边区。卡斯蒂利亚内战期间，城镇效忠佩德罗一世，而总主教支持他的对手。15世纪初，城堡得到修缮，并增建一座主塔。

english:
Ccantumarcani lies beneath the great mountain of Potosí, a cold highland place transformed by the discovery of silver. The conical Cerro Rico rises above the settlement, its mineral veins making Potosí one of the richest and most populous cities of Spanish America. A vast mining landscape of shafts, mills, reservoirs and roads grew around the mountain.

After silver began to be exploited by the Spanish in 1545, the town expanded rapidly. Viceroy Francisco de Toledo reorganised mining labour in the 1570s, requiring Indigenous communities across a wide region to send workers under the mita. Mercury amalgamation and water-powered mills made it possible to process large quantities of ore, and production reached its height after 1580. The mills and reservoirs formed an elaborate system around the mountain, bringing water to the machinery that crushed and treated the ore. This wealth rested on dangerous and exhausting work, as well as the displacement of people brought to the mines.

Silver from Potosí circulated throughout the Spanish empire and beyond, while the city drew merchants, artisans and labourers from distant places. Its mint turned metal into coin, and its churches and convents expressed the wealth concentrated at the foot of the mountain. Behind the splendour stood the demands of the mines, which shaped the lives of communities across the southern Andes for generations.
simp_chinese:
坎图马尔卡尼位于波托西巨山脚下，这片寒冷高地因银矿发现而彻底改变。圆锥形的富山高耸于聚落之上，山中矿脉使波托西成为西属美洲最富庶、人口最多的城市之一。矿井、磨坊、水库与道路环绕山峰，构成庞大的采矿景观。

1545年西班牙人开始开采银矿后，城镇迅速扩张。总督弗朗西斯科·德·托莱多于1570年代重组矿业劳役，要求广大地区的原住民社群依米塔制度派出工人。汞齐法和水力磨坊使大量矿石得以处理，1580年后产量达到高峰。磨坊和水库在山周围构成精密的系统，为粉碎和处理矿石的机械提供水力。这份财富建立在危险而艰苦的劳动之上，也伴随着人们被迫迁往矿山。

波托西的白银流通于西班牙帝国及更远地区，城市吸引了来自远方的商人、工匠和劳工。铸币厂把金属铸成钱币，教堂和修道院体现出汇聚于山脚的财富。繁华背后是矿山源源不断的需求，世代影响着整个南安第斯社群的生活。

english: Ce’eiinox, or “Game Bag,” is an Arapaho name for the country around Grand Lake in the Rocky Mountains. The deep lake lies below the Continental Divide near the headwaters of the Colorado River, in a basin shaped by glaciers. Arapaho people spent summers in the mountains following game, then moved towards the plains for winter. They also called Grand Lake beteeni’ec, “Holy Lake.”
simp_chinese: 塞伊诺克斯意为“猎物袋”，是阿拉帕霍人对落基山脉大湖一带的称呼。深邃的湖泊位于大陆分水岭之下、科罗拉多河源头附近，湖盆由冰川塑造。阿拉帕霍人夏季在山中追随猎物，冬季迁往平原。他们也称大湖为 beteeni’ec，意为“圣湖”。

english: The Purcell Mountains rise west of the upper Columbia valley, their high ridges carrying glaciers and snowfields. Mount Farnham stands among the peaks above Toby Creek. To the north, the Toby Glacier feeds the creek as it descends toward the Columbia. A route over the Purcell crest links the Toby drainage with Hamill Creek and Kootenay Lake, a crossing used by First Nations people for generations.
simp_chinese: 珀塞尔山脉耸立在哥伦比亚河上游谷地以西，高山脊上覆盖着冰川和雪原。法纳姆山是托比溪上方群峰之一；北面的托比冰川为溪流补给水源，溪水向哥伦比亚河流去。一条翻越珀塞尔山脊的路线连接托比溪流域、哈米尔溪与库特尼湖，原住民世代使用这条通道。

sources.title: Purcell Wilderness Conservancy Provincial Park and Protected Area

english: Cev’aq lies in the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta, a low country of winding rivers, lakes and tundra near the Bering Sea. Its people identify as Cup’ik, and their language is a distinct variety of Central Yup’ik. Before the arrival of outsiders, Cup’ik communities lived along the Kashunuk River; older settlements include Qissunaq and Qavinaq. Fishing and the seasonal harvest of birds and other animals joined the people of the river to the surrounding wetlands and coast. The waterways were both a source of food and routes between settlements.
simp_chinese: 塞瓦克位于育空—库斯科奎姆三角洲，白令海附近的低地布满曲折河流、湖泊和苔原。这里的人们自称丘皮克，他们的语言是中央尤皮克语的一个独特变体。外来者抵达之前，丘皮克社群居住在卡舒努克河沿岸，旧聚落包括基苏纳克和卡维纳克。捕鱼及季节性捕获鸟类和其他动物，使河岸居民与周围湿地及海岸紧密相连；水道既提供食物，也连接各处聚落。

english:
Cedar Lake lies in the lake-strewn country of northern Keewatin, west of Hudson Bay and within the waterways of the Oceko Sipiy region. The name Keewatin comes from Algonquian terms describing the north wind, while Inuktitut names distinguish the same high northern country through the geography of Kivalliq. Countless small lakes and connecting channels break the forest and tundra into seasonal routes.

Cree and Dene families used lakes, rivers and winter trails for fishing, hunting and travel across long distances. Canoes followed open water in summer, while snowshoes, sledges and frozen lakes made a different network in winter. Water shaped where camps could be placed and how furs, fish and other goods moved between communities.

The land remained thinly peopled because cold winters and great distances made permanent settlement difficult. Northern lakes concentrated fish and game within an otherwise open landscape, giving travellers dependable stopping places. Cedar Lake therefore belongs to a northern world organized by water and seasonal movement, not by dense agriculture or a single urban centre.
simp_chinese:
雪松湖位于基瓦廷北部的多湖地带，在哈得孙湾以西，属于奥切科·西皮伊地区的水路网络。基瓦廷名称来自阿尔冈昆语中表示北风的词，因纽特语名称则以基瓦利克等称谓区分同一片北方土地。无数小湖与连接水道把森林和苔原切成季节通道。

克里人与德内家庭利用湖泊、河流和冬季道路捕鱼、狩猎并远行。夏季独木舟沿开放水面移动，冬季则改用雪鞋、雪橇和冰封湖面。水源决定营地位置，也影响毛皮、鱼类和其他货物如何在社群之间流通。

严寒冬季与辽阔距离使人口长期稀少。北方湖泊在开阔环境中聚集鱼群和猎物，为旅人提供可靠停歇处。雪松湖属于由水域与季节迁徙组织的北方世界，而非密集农业或单一城市中心。湖区连接森林猎场和北部水路，使小规模营地能够跟随鱼群、兽群与冰情移动。

english: Ceduna lies on the western coast of the Eyre Peninsula, where sheltered waters of the Great Australian Bight meet sandy plains. The surrounding country is associated with Wirangu-speaking Aboriginal communities. Long before the arrival of European settlement, people maintained connections along the coast and inland, using the resources of both environments.
simp_chinese: 塞杜纳位于艾尔半岛西岸，大澳大利亚湾的庇护水域与沙质平原在此相接。周围土地与使用维兰古语的原住民社群有关。欧洲人定居之前很久，当地人已维系沿海与内陆联系，并利用两种环境的资源。

english: Ceeldheer lies in the dry interior of Mudug, west of the Indian Ocean coast. Low hills, sandy ground and seasonal watercourses break the plains of central Somalia. The name refers to a deep well, a valuable feature in pastoral country where surface water does not last throughout the year. Herders travel across the surrounding rangelands as rain and pasture shift with the seasons.
simp_chinese: 切勒代尔位于穆杜格干旱的内陆，在印度洋海岸以西。低丘、沙地和季节性水道点缀着索马里中部平原。地名意为深井；在地表水不能终年保存的牧区，水井尤其珍贵。牧民随着降雨和牧草的季节变化，穿行于周围的放牧地。

english: Ceepee lies near a bend of the North Saskatchewan River in central Saskatchewan. The river winds through a broad valley between wooded banks and prairie, carrying water east from the Rocky Mountains. This country formed part of the travel and trading routes of Cree and other Indigenous peoples. Farther west, the Battle River joins the North Saskatchewan, bringing together waterways that cross the parkland and plains.
simp_chinese: 西皮位于萨斯喀彻温中部北萨斯喀彻温河的一处河湾附近。河水在林木河岸与草原之间的宽阔河谷中蜿蜒，把落基山脉的水向东输送。这片土地属于克里人及其他原住民的旅行和贸易路线。更西方的巴特尔河汇入北萨斯喀彻温河，将穿过公园林地和平原的水道汇合起来。

sources.title: Surveys of the North Saskatchewan River - 1910-1915 (IA surveysofnorthsa00lrvo).pdf

english:
Cefalù lies on Sicily's northern coast beneath a great rocky height overlooking the Tyrrhenian Sea. Its cathedral, with twin towers and brilliant mosaics, dominates the town between the rock and the shore. Roger II founded the church in 1131, soon after becoming king of Sicily. Its intended role as a royal monument gave the coastal town a place in the ambitions of his dynasty.

Building continued for more than a century before the cathedral was consecrated in 1267. The image of Christ in the apse and the painted wooden ceiling reflect the different artistic traditions that met in Norman Sicily. The fortress-like church remained the centre of Cefalù's bishopric and a prominent landmark for sailors approaching the Sicilian coastal town by sea.
simp_chinese:
切法卢位于西西里北岸，一座巨大岩山俯瞰第勒尼安海。双塔大教堂及其绚丽马赛克统领着山岩与海岸之间的城镇。罗杰二世在成为西西里国王后不久，于1131年创建这座教堂，原本希望它成为王朝的纪念建筑，使这座沿海城镇成为王室抱负的一部分。

工程持续一个多世纪，教堂于1267年祝圣。后殿的基督像与彩绘木天花板体现了在诺曼西西里交汇的艺术传统。这座外观如堡垒的教堂仍是切法卢主教区的中心，也是从海上接近城镇时醒目的地标。

english: Cegani stands on the Borcea branch of the Danube, among the villages bordering the wetlands of Ialomița. Its name has been associated with the sterlet, a fish found in these waters. Documents mention the village repeatedly in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, and eighteenth-century maps also record it under forms such as Tegani. The surrounding floodplain supplied fisheries and pastures alongside the cultivated land of the settlement.
simp_chinese: 切加尼位于多瑙河的博尔恰支流边，是伊雅洛米察湿地周围的村庄之一。当地人将村名与生活在这些水域中的小体鲟联系起来。十六、十七世纪的文书多次提到此村，十八世纪地图上也可见特加尼等名称。村庄周围除耕地外，洪泛平原还提供渔场和牧地。

english: Ceheng lies in the mountains north of the Nanpan River. Under the Qing it was one of the districts beyond the river administered by Xilong in Guangxi. In 1727 the court transferred the northern bank to Guizhou and established an assistant prefect at Ceheng. The river thus became an administrative boundary through country previously linked under a single jurisdiction.
simp_chinese: 册亨位于南盘江北面的山地。清初，它是广西西隆州管辖的江外地区之一。雍正五年（1727年），朝廷将江北地区划归贵州，并设册亨州同。江水由此成为行政界线，分开了原属同一辖区的地区。

english: Ceibal was a Maya city on high ground above the Pasión River in southern Petén. Its plazas and carved monuments overlooked a waterway linking the interior with the Usumacinta. In 735 its ruler was captured by the neighboring kingdom of Dos Pilas. The city later revived, and in 830 a new lord, Wat’ul Chatel, was installed. Its ninth-century sculpture displays a striking mixture of traditions, but by around 900 the great center had largely been abandoned.
simp_chinese: 塞瓦尔是一座玛雅城市，坐落于佩滕南部帕西翁河畔的高地。广场和雕刻石碑俯瞰河流；这条水道将内陆与乌苏马辛塔河连接起来。735年，邻近的多斯皮拉斯王国俘获了塞瓦尔的统治者。城市后来复兴，830年新领主瓦图尔·查特尔即位。九世纪的雕刻展现了不同传统的鲜明融合，但到约900年，这座大中心已基本被废弃。

english:
Celano rises on the northern side of the Fucino basin, beneath the mountains of Abruzzo. Its castle dominates the town and once looked across the waters of Lake Fucino. The counts of Celano made this a centre of their power, controlling land and routes around the lake. The basin offered fertile low ground, enclosed on all sides by high ridges and mountain passes.

Pietro Berardi began building the great castle around 1392. Work continued under later lords, including Lionello Accrocciamuro, who raised the principal storey and corner towers. In 1463 Antonio Todeschini Piccolomini received the county and completed the great fortress. Its imposing walls and residential rooms expressed both the military authority and the noble status of the families that governed Celano.
simp_chinese:
切拉诺坐落在阿布鲁佐群山下、富奇诺盆地北侧。城堡俯瞰城镇，昔日也面向富奇诺湖水。切拉诺伯爵以这里为权力中心，控制湖泊周围的土地与道路。盆地低地肥沃，四面环绕高山脊与山口。

约1392年，彼得罗·贝拉尔迪开始修建大城堡。后来的领主继续施工，包括修建主体楼层与角塔的利奥内洛·阿克罗恰穆罗。1463年，安东尼奥·托代斯基尼·皮科洛米尼取得伯国，完成堡垒。雄伟城墙与居室共同展现统治切拉诺的家族的军事权威和地位。

english: The Celebes Sea lies north of Sulawesi and east of Borneo, opening southwards into the Makassar Strait. Its waters separate the Indonesian islands from the Sulu archipelago and Mindanao to the north. Deep open sea gives way to island channels and coastal waters around its margins, linking the Pacific with the seas of the Indonesian archipelago.
simp_chinese: 苏拉威西海位于苏拉威西以北、婆罗洲以东，向南通往望加锡海峡。它将印度尼西亚诸岛与北面的苏禄群岛、棉兰老岛分开。深邃外海在边缘转为岛间水道和近岸水域，将太平洋与印度尼西亚群岛的海洋连接起来。

sources.title: Regional State of Ocean and Coasts 2021 The East Asian Seas Region VOLUME 1.pdf

english: North of Sulawesi, the Celebes Sea extends towards the southern Philippines. The Sangihe Islands rise to the east along a chain between Sulawesi and Mindanao, while the sea opens westwards towards Borneo and the Sulu archipelago. Its deep waters form part of the broad maritime space between the islands of Indonesia and the Philippines.
simp_chinese: 苏拉威西以北的苏拉威西海向菲律宾南部延伸。东面的桑义赫群岛沿苏拉威西与棉兰老岛之间的岛链升起，海域向西则通往婆罗洲和苏禄群岛。深海构成印度尼西亚与菲律宾诸岛之间广阔海域的一部分。

english: The northern Celebes Sea lies between the Sulu archipelago, Mindanao and the islands north of Sulawesi. To the east the Sangihe chain separates these waters from the Maluku Sea, its volcanic islands rising between the two larger shores. To the west the sea reaches towards the islands and coasts of northeastern Borneo.
simp_chinese: 苏拉威西海北部位于苏禄群岛、棉兰老岛与苏拉威西北方诸岛之间。东面的桑义赫岛链将这片海域与马鲁古海分隔，火山岛屿耸立在两座大岛之间。海水向西延伸，通往婆罗洲东北部的岛屿与海岸。

english:
Celje lies in the lower Savinja valley beneath its castle. The Roman town of Celeia received municipal rights under Emperor Claudius in 45 and stood on the road from Aquileia to Pannonia. Rebuilt in the early Middle Ages, Celje became the seat of the counts of Celje in 1341. Their castle overlooked a market town at the meeting of several rivers and roads.

The counts gained princely rank in 1436, and Frederick II granted Celje town privileges in 1451. When the dynasty died out in 1456, the Habsburgs inherited its lands. Walls and a moat were built in 1473. During the Slovene peasant revolt of 1515, rebels took the old castle but the town held out. Many nobles adopted Protestantism during the Reformation, before Catholicism was restored in the Counter-Reformation.
simp_chinese:
采列坐落在下萨维尼亚谷地，城堡高踞其上。罗马城市采莱亚于公元四十五年在克劳狄皇帝治下获得城市权，位于阿奎莱亚通往潘诺尼亚的道路上。早期中世纪重建后，采列于1341年成为采列伯爵的驻地。城堡俯瞰多条河流和道路交会处的集镇。

伯爵家族于1436年获得亲王地位，腓特烈二世于1451年授予采列城市特权。1456年家族绝嗣，哈布斯堡家族继承其领地；1473年，城市修筑城墙和护城河。1515年斯洛文尼亚农民起义期间，起义者攻占旧城堡，但城镇守住了。宗教改革期间许多贵族改信新教，随后反宗教改革恢复了天主教。

english:
Celle stands where the Fuhse meets the Aller, on a sandy rise in a river valley crossed by trading roads. In 1292 Duke Otto the Strict moved the settlement and his castle downstream from older Celle to this site. The new town gained a church and a fortified ducal seat, while the navigable Aller connected it to the Weser.

During the Lüneburg War of Succession the dukes increasingly used Celle as a residence. From 1433 it became the permanent court of the Welf principality of Lüneburg. The castle was enlarged with halls and a chapel to accommodate the court, and the town's timber-framed houses grew around it. Celle remained a centre of princely government until the local line died out in 1705. The end of the resident court changed the town's fortunes, although the castle continued to receive distinguished occupants. Caroline Matilda, the exiled queen of Denmark, lived at Celle from 1772 until her death in 1775. Its palace and church preserve the memory of the rulers who made this river town their home.
simp_chinese:
策勒坐落在富泽河汇入阿勒河的地方，位于商路穿越的河谷沙地上。1292年，严厉者奥托公爵将聚落和城堡从旧策勒沿河迁至此地。新城获得教堂和设防的公爵驻地，可通航的阿勒河则将它与威悉河连接起来。

吕讷堡继承战争期间，公爵越来越多地以策勒为驻地。自1433年起，它成为韦尔夫家族吕讷堡公国的永久宫廷所在地。城堡增建大厅和礼拜堂以容纳宫廷，木筋房屋在周围发展起来。策勒一直是亲王政府中心，直到当地支系于1705年绝嗣。驻跸宫廷的结束改变了城镇的命运，但城堡仍接待显贵住客。流亡的丹麦王后卡罗琳·玛蒂尔德自1772年居于策勒，1775年在此去世。宫殿和教堂保存着那些以这座河畔城镇为家的统治者的记忆。

english:
These waters cover the Atlantic shelf south of Ireland and west of Wales, Cornwall, Devon and Brittany. They connect the Saint George's Channel, Bristol Channel and English Channel with the deeper Atlantic and the approaches to Biscay. The Isles of Scilly lie within this open sea as a low cluster of islands. Atlantic swells meet the rising sea floor here, while separate wave systems arrive from the adjacent channels. The result is short, confused water in gales and heavy surf along exposed coasts. Shoals and islands provide a few landmarks, but the western edge offers little shelter from deep-ocean weather.

Fishing and coastal shipping long crossed these waters between the British Isles and Brittany. Ships bound for Atlantic ports used the channels on either side, where tides, headlands and changing winds determined progress. Shoals such as the Scillies and Fastnet were both landmarks and hazards, while storms could scatter fleets beyond sight of land. Local pilots and knowledge of tides helped sailors cross the exposed approaches.
simp_chinese:
这片水域覆盖爱尔兰以南、威尔士、康沃尔、德文与布列塔尼以西的大西洋陆架，把圣乔治海峡、布里斯托尔海峡和英吉利海峡同较深的大西洋、比斯开湾入口连接起来。锡利群岛作为低矮岛群散布在开阔海面。大西洋涌浪在这里遇到抬升的海底，来自两侧海峡的波系又与其相交，风暴时形成短促而混乱的波浪，并猛烈拍击外露海岸。浅滩和岛屿只提供少量地标，西缘仍缺少躲避深洋天气的屏障。

不列颠群岛与布列塔尼之间的捕鱼和沿岸航运长期穿过此地。前往大西洋港口的船只选择两侧海峡，潮汐、岬角和风向决定航程。锡利群岛和法斯奈特附近的浅滩既是地标也是险区，风暴还会把船队吹散到望不见陆地的外海。地方引航员和潮汐知识帮助船员穿越暴露的接近水道。

english: Çeltik lies on the high plain of central Anatolia, in the Konya region, at an elevation of about 870 metres. Its name is the Turkish word for paddy, meaning rice still in its husk, which points to rice cultivation in the district. The open plateau around it is dry and cold, with grain fields and pastures spread across the plain, and villages scattered around a small central town.
simp_chinese: 切尔蒂克位于安纳托利亚中部科尼亚地区的高原上，海拔约870米。土耳其语名称意为稻田，或仍带稻壳的稻谷，指向当地的稻作。周围的开阔高原干燥寒冷，谷物田地与牧场铺展于平原之上，村落散布在一座小型中心城镇的周围。

english: Cêmar Co lies in a high basin of the western Changtang, southeast of another inland lake, Gangmar Co. At more than 4,500 metres above sea level, Cêmar Co occupies a depression among the open uplands of the Tibetan Plateau. The region is cold and dry, with little rain and a great difference between daytime and nighttime temperatures. Mountains separate the lake basins across this part of the plateau.
simp_chinese: 杰玛错位于羌塘西部的高原盆地，在另一座内陆湖岗玛错的东南方。杰玛错海拔四千五百多米，坐落在青藏高原开阔高地之间的洼地中。这里气候寒冷干燥，降水稀少，昼夜温差很大；山脉将这一地区的湖泊盆地分隔开来。

english:
Çemişgezek lies among the valleys north of the Euphrates, in a mountainous district ruled for centuries by local lords. Its principality commanded numerous fortresses and settlements, linking the uplands of Dersim with the approaches to Harput. Armenian communities lived alongside the Muslim population, leaving records of their own in manuscript colophons, including a fifteenth-century record naming a local Armenian deputy under Qara Yuluk.

In the early sixteenth century the region became involved in the struggle between the Safavids and Ottomans. After the battle of Chaldiran, Pir Hüseyin sought the return of his father's lands from Sultan Selim. Ottoman forces brought Çemişgezek into their realm in 1515, while local rulers continued to play a part in the administration and military affairs of the frontier.
simp_chinese:
切米什盖泽克位于幼发拉底河以北的河谷之间，其山区数百年来由地方领主管辖。公国控制着众多堡垒和聚落，将德尔西姆高地与通往哈尔普特的道路相连。亚美尼亚社群与穆斯林居民共同生活，并在手稿题记中留下了自己的记载，其中一份十五世纪题记提到卡拉·于吕克治下的一名亚美尼亚副官。

十六世纪初，这一地区卷入萨法维与奥斯曼的争斗。查尔迪兰战役后，皮尔·侯赛因请求苏丹塞利姆归还其父亲的领地。1515年，奥斯曼军队将切米什盖泽克纳入帝国，而地方统治者仍在边疆的行政和军事事务中发挥作用。

english: Cempaga lies on a branch of the Mentaya River in southern Borneo. The Mentaya runs south to Sampit Bay and the Java Sea, dividing into several waterways north of Sampit. The Cempaga is among its navigable branches, giving communities beside it access to the larger river and the coast. In this wet, forested country the waterways form a natural network through which people and goods can travel between the interior and the sea.
simp_chinese: 陈帕加位于婆罗洲南部门塔亚河的一条支流上。门塔亚河向南流入桑皮特湾与爪哇海，在桑皮特以北分出几条水道。陈帕加河是其中可航行的支流之一，使沿岸居民能够进入主河道并通往海岸。在这片潮湿多林的土地上，水道组成天然网络，人员和货物可沿其往来于内陆与海洋之间。

english:
Cempoala stood near the Actopan River in the warm coastal plain of Veracruz. One of the principal centres of the Totonac world, it had temples, walled precincts and channels that carried water from the river to houses and fields. Rounded river stones and lime plaster formed the walls of its buildings. By the early sixteenth century the city was subject to Mexica rule.

In 1519 its ruler Chicomácatl made an alliance with Hernán Cortés against the Mexica. Cempoalan leaders supplied knowledge of the region and support to the Spaniards as they prepared to march toward the central highlands. Their alliance was one of the first in a network of Indigenous partnerships that shaped the campaign against Tenochtitlan. The fall of Mexica power did not end colonial demands on the coast, but Cempoala’s decision became a decisive moment in the conquest.
simp_chinese:
森波阿拉坐落在韦拉克鲁斯温暖海岸平原的阿克托潘河附近，是托托纳克世界的主要中心之一。城中有神庙、围墙建筑群和水渠，河水被引入住宅与田地。建筑墙体使用圆润的河石和石灰灰泥。十六世纪初，这座城市受墨西加人统治。

1519年，统治者奇科马卡特尔与埃尔南·科尔特斯结盟对抗墨西加人。西班牙人准备向中部高地进军时，森波阿拉领袖提供了地方知识与支持。这是塑造进攻特诺奇蒂特兰战役的原住民联盟网络中最早的盟约之一。墨西加势力倒台并未结束殖民当局对海岸的要求，但森波阿拉的决定成为征服过程中的关键时刻。

english: Cèmuhî is a Kanak language of the Touho region on New Caledonia’s Grande Terre. The island’s central mountains fall towards the eastern coast, where valleys open onto a lagoon protected by a long barrier reef. Cèmuhî and neighbouring Paicî are among the many distinct languages of an island whose communities maintained their own lands and customary relationships.
simp_chinese: 塞穆希语是新喀里多尼亚大岛图奥地区的卡纳克语言。大岛中央山脉向东岸下降，河谷通往由绵长堡礁庇护的潟湖。塞穆希语与邻近的派奇语只是岛上众多不同语言中的两种；当地各社群拥有自己的土地和习惯关系。

english: Cenderawasih Bay forms a great inlet on New Guinea’s northern coast, with islands and coastal communities spread around its waters. Biak-speaking voyagers moved westward toward Raja Ampat, according to oral traditions. These connections linked the bay to wider exchanges involving Tidore and Maluku.
simp_chinese: 仙德拉瓦西湾是新几内亚北岸的大海湾，岛屿和沿岸社群散布在周围。口述传统记载，说比亚克语的航海者从海湾向西迁往拉贾安帕特。这些联系将海湾与涉及蒂多雷和马鲁古的更广泛交换相连。

english: The islands of Cenderawasih Bay lie off the northern coast of western New Guinea. Biak and Yapen are separated from the mainland and each other by broad passages, with reefs and smaller islands scattered between them. The bay’s shores and islands were connected by canoe voyages, and Biak-speaking seafarers also travelled west towards Raja Ampat and the Maluku Islands.
simp_chinese: 极乐鸟湾诸岛位于新几内亚西部北岸外海。比亚克与亚彭分别与大陆及彼此隔着宽阔水道，其间散布着礁石和小岛。独木舟航行连接海湾的海岸与诸岛，使用比亚克语的航海者也向西前往拉贾安帕特和马鲁古群岛。

english:
Ceneda stands among the hills of the Veneto, near the northern approaches to the plain. Its neighbour Serravalle guarded a narrow route through the hills, but the two were distinct communities in the age of bishops and Venetian rule.

Ceneda was the seat of a bishopric and, from the early medieval period, its bishops also held temporal authority as counts. In 1388 the town came under Venice, yet the bishops resisted the republic’s full authority over their county for centuries. Venice finally suppressed the county in 1768. Ecclesiastical jurisdiction and secular lordship thus overlapped around the cathedral and the bishop’s residence, linking the town’s history to both Rome and the politics of the Venetian mainland.
simp_chinese:
切内达位于威尼托丘陵之间，靠近通往平原北部的道路。邻近的塞拉瓦莱扼守穿越丘陵的狭窄通道；在主教与威尼斯统治的时代，两地仍是各自独立的社区。

切内达是主教座城，自中世纪早期起，当地主教兼有伯爵的世俗权力。1388年城镇归于威尼斯，但主教们在此后数世纪中继续抵制共和国对其伯国的完全控制。1768年威尼斯最终废除了伯国。大教堂和主教驻所周围，教会管辖权与世俗领主权长期交叠，使这座城镇同时与罗马和威尼斯大陆领地的政治相连。

english: Cengtai lies among the mountains east of Bijie, in the old Shuixi country of northwestern Guizhou. The Ming built a fort here and established Cengtai Guard in the late fourteenth century, placing soldiers in a district where hereditary chiefs also held authority. The guard was later abolished and replaced by a subordinate post of Chishui Guard. Its walls and garrison were part of the Ming effort to hold the roads and passes through the mountainous approaches to Sichuan and Yunnan.
simp_chinese: 层台位于毕节以东的山地，属于黔西北水西旧地。明朝在此筑城，并于十四世纪末设层台卫，在世袭土司仍有权力的地方驻军。层台卫后来撤销，改设赤水卫下属千户所。城墙与驻军是明朝控制通往四川、云南山路的一部分。

english: The Cenrana River drains the lake country of southern Sulawesi towards the Gulf of Bone. Near Lake Tempe, its course links inland settlements with the eastern coast of the peninsula. Tosora, a capital of Wajo in the seventeenth century, stood near this river and the lake, part of a landscape where waterways connected the Bugis kingdoms.
simp_chinese: 岑拉纳河将苏拉威西南部湖区的水流带向博内湾。河道连接特姆佩湖附近的内陆聚落与半岛东岸。十七世纪瓦约都城托索拉位于河流与湖泊附近，是水路连接布吉诸王国的地区之一。

english: The central Apennines form a backbone between Umbria and the Adriatic slopes of the Marche. Among their limestone massifs are the Sibillini Mountains, cut by deep valleys and crowned by peaks rising above two thousand metres. Glaciers shaped cirques and valleys here in colder ages, while the high ridge gives way eastward to the river valleys leading toward the sea.
simp_chinese: 中亚平宁山脉构成翁布里亚与马尔凯亚得里亚海一侧之间的脊梁。石灰岩山地中有西比利尼山脉，深邃河谷切入山体，多座山峰高于两千米。更寒冷的时代，冰川塑造了山中的冰斗和谷地；高山脊向东逐渐过渡为通往海洋的河谷。

english: The central Apennines form a chain of high ridges and enclosed valleys across Abruzzo. North of the Gran Sasso, the mountains continue towards the ranges dividing the Adriatic slopes from the interior of Italy. Snow and exposed rock crown the heights, while streams descend through wooded valleys. The rugged country breaks travel into a succession of passes and basins, each set apart by the limestone peaks around it.
simp_chinese: 中亚平宁山脉横贯阿布鲁佐，由高山脊和封闭谷地组成。大萨索山以北，群山继续延伸，分隔亚得里亚海坡地与意大利内陆。积雪与裸岩覆盖高处，溪流穿过林木茂密的山谷向下奔流。崎岖地形使旅途由一连串山口与盆地组成，每座盆地都被周围石灰岩山峰隔开。

english: The Gran Sasso rises in the central Apennines above the valleys of Abruzzo. Its highest summit, Corno Grande, is the loftiest peak of the entire Apennine chain. Steep limestone faces and high pastures overlook the country between the Adriatic and the inland basins. Snow and cold linger on the upper slopes, while rivers carry water away through valleys cut between the great mountain ridges.
simp_chinese: 大萨索山在阿布鲁佐河谷上方耸立，是中亚平宁山脉的一部分。最高峰大角峰是整条亚平宁山脉的最高点。陡峭的石灰岩壁和高山牧场俯瞰亚得里亚海与内陆盆地之间的土地。高坡积雪和寒冷持续较久，河流则经山脊之间的谷地流向远方。

english: The mountains of central Abruzzo surround the basin of L'Aquila and the valley of the Aterno. Ridges of the Gran Sasso and neighbouring ranges rise above the basin, separating it from the Adriatic slopes and the valleys farther west. High pastures and rocky summits contrast with the settled low ground, where roads follow the river and cross the mountains through passes. Winter snow gives the heights a different rhythm from the sheltered basin below.
simp_chinese: 阿布鲁佐中部群山环绕拉奎拉盆地与阿泰尔诺河谷。大萨索山及邻近山脉的山脊耸立于盆地上方，将其与亚得里亚海坡地和西面的河谷分开。高山牧场与岩石峰顶同有聚落的低地形成对照；道路沿河而行，再经山口穿越群山。冬雪使高处呈现出不同于下方避风盆地的季节节奏。

english: The mountains around the Fucino basin form part of the central Apennines of Abruzzo. Their ridges enclose a broad inland hollow that for centuries held Lake Fucino, with settlements on the slopes above its waters. Beyond the heights lie the valleys of the Liri and the Aterno. The contrast between the mountain walls and the low ground within them gives this part of the Apennines its distinctive shape.
simp_chinese: 富奇诺盆地周围的群山属于阿布鲁佐中亚平宁山脉。山脊环绕着宽广的内陆洼地，数百年来富奇诺湖占据其间，聚落位于湖水上方的坡地。越过高地便是利里与阿泰尔诺河谷。山墙与其间低地的鲜明反差，构成这段亚平宁山脉独特的形态。

english: In the central Apennines, Mount Sirente and the Maiella rise on either side of the inland valleys of Abruzzo. Between the ranges lies the Peligna basin around Sulmona, while farther south the high plateau of Cinquemiglia leads towards the upper Sangro. Limestone ridges, cold uplands and enclosed valleys make the country a succession of distinct landscapes, crossed by routes that must climb from one basin to the next.
simp_chinese: 中亚平宁山脉中，锡伦泰山与马耶拉山分别耸立在阿布鲁佐内陆河谷两侧。山脉之间是苏尔莫纳周围的佩利尼亚盆地，更南面的钦奎米利亚高原通向桑格罗河上游。石灰岩山脊、寒冷高地与封闭谷地构成一系列不同地貌，道路必须攀越山岭，才能从一个盆地抵达另一个。

english: The central Apennines rise above the Adriatic slopes of Abruzzo, where the great limestone mass of the Maiella overlooks valleys running towards the sea. High ridges divide the inland basins from the coastal hills, and snow lies on the summits in winter. The earthquake of 1706 shook communities on both sides of the Maiella, a reminder that the mountains are as changeable beneath the ground as they appear enduring above it.
simp_chinese: 中亚平宁山脉耸立在阿布鲁佐的亚得里亚海一侧，巨大的马耶拉石灰岩山体俯瞰通向海洋的河谷。高山脊将内陆盆地与沿海丘陵分开，冬季山顶覆雪。1706年地震震动了马耶拉两侧的聚落，提醒人们看似恒久的群山下方也会发生剧烈变化。

english: The central North Atlantic contains the Sargasso Sea, a region bounded by ocean currents rather than land and named for its floating Sargassum seaweed. To its north, the Gulf Stream carries warm water towards Europe. In the eighteenth century Benjamin Franklin and Timothy Folger charted the current to help transatlantic navigators.
simp_chinese: 北大西洋中部有马尾藻海，它以漂浮的马尾藻命名，边界由洋流而非陆地构成。北面的墨西哥湾暖流将暖水输向欧洲。十八世纪，本杰明·富兰克林和蒂莫西·福尔杰绘制洋流海图，帮助横渡大西洋的航海者。

english: The central Baltic lies between Gotland and the eastern shores of the sea, crossed by routes that joined Scandinavian, German and eastern markets. Gotland's position made Visby a natural stopping place for merchants, and from the twelfth to the fourteenth century it was a leading centre of Baltic commerce. Vessels carried salt, cloth and metal eastwards, returning with goods such as wax and furs from the trading networks reaching Novgorod.
simp_chinese: 中波罗的海位于哥得兰岛与东岸之间，横贯其间的航线连接斯堪的纳维亚、德意志和东方市场。哥得兰岛的位置使维斯比成为商旅的天然停泊地，十二至十四世纪间，它是波罗的海贸易的重要中心。船只向东运送盐、布匹和金属，又通过延伸至诺夫哥罗德的贸易网络带回蜂蜡、毛皮等货物。

english:
The central Cascade Range cuts across Oregon and Washington as a belt of forested ridges, river valleys and prominent volcanoes. It divides moist Pacific slopes from the drier interior, producing dense conifer forest west of the crest and more open woodland and grassland eastward. Snow persists on high ridges into summer, while rivers cross the mountains through deep valleys and comparatively low passes.

Native communities used these passes for hunting, gathering and travel between the Columbia Plateau and the coast. Trails followed rivers, ridgelines and known snow-free corridors; high country supplied berries, game and obsidian-like exchange goods, while lower valleys supported winter villages. The mountains were difficult but not empty: their routes tied peoples across different ecological zones.

Volcanic activity repeatedly altered the landscape. The 1800 eruption of Mount St. Helens was recorded by Native oral traditions and by tree rings, and other Cascade peaks produced ash, lahars and landslides. Travel depended on the season, the state of river crossings and knowledge of unstable slopes. For preindustrial movement, the central Cascades formed a mountainous world of controlled passages rather than a continuous open frontier.
simp_chinese:
喀斯喀特山脉中部横贯俄勒冈与华盛顿，由森林山脊、河谷和醒目火山组成。它把湿润的太平洋坡面同干燥内陆分开，山脊以西多密针叶林，向东则转为较开阔林地和草原。高地积雪可延续到夏季，河流又通过深谷和相对低矮山口切穿山脉。

原住民社群利用这些山口在哥伦比亚高原与海岸之间狩猎、采集和旅行。步道沿河流、山脊和已知无雪通道展开；高地提供浆果、猎物和交换物资，低河谷则维系冬季村落。山脉难以穿越却绝非空白，其路线把不同生态区的族群连接起来。

火山活动不断改写地貌。圣海伦斯山1800年的喷发被原住民口述传统和树木年轮记录下来，其他喀斯喀特火山也产生火山灰、火山泥流和滑坡。行旅取决于季节、渡河状况以及对不稳定山坡的认识。对前工业时代而言，这一地区是由可控山口组成的高山世界，而非连续开放的边疆。

english: In the dry country of the Ewaso Ng'iro basin, the river carries water from Mount Kenya and the Aberdares toward the Lorian Swamp. Its wetlands spread across a lowland otherwise marked by aridity. The name Dahalo is associated with a Cushitic language of Kenya's eastern coast and with communities whose older livelihoods included hunting and gathering, in a region of many neighboring languages and peoples.
simp_chinese: 埃瓦索恩吉罗河流域地势干旱，河水从肯尼亚山与阿伯德尔山流向洛里安沼泽，在低地形成一片湿地。达哈洛之名与肯尼亚东海岸的一种库施特语及其社群有关，这些社群较早的生计包括狩猎和采集，周围则生活着使用多种语言的邻人。

english: East of Adama, the Awash runs through the Ethiopian Rift toward the dry Afar country. Near Welenchiti, the river divides the surrounding uplands from the rift floor, where volcanic landforms and valleys mark the landscape. Unlike the rivers flowing west to the Nile, the Awash ends in a chain of lakes in the Afar depression.
simp_chinese: 阿达玛以东，阿瓦什河穿过埃塞俄比亚裂谷，流向干旱的阿法尔地区。在韦伦奇蒂附近，河流经过高地与裂谷底部之间，火山地貌和谷地交错分布。阿瓦什河不像向西流入尼罗河的河流，而是最终消失在阿法尔洼地的一串湖泊中。

english: The central basin of Lake Erie spreads between the island-strewn western waters and the deeper eastern basin. Its broad floor is comparatively even, with an average depth of about eighteen metres. A submerged ridge of sand and gravel runs from Long Point towards the southern shore, separating it from the eastern basin. Lake Erie is the shallowest of the Great Lakes, and winds can readily stir its waters into waves.
simp_chinese: 伊利湖中部盆地位于多岛的西部水域与更深的东部盆地之间。宽阔的湖底较为平坦，平均水深约十八米。一条水下沙砾脊从朗角向南岸延伸，将中部与东部盆地分开。伊利湖是五大湖中最浅的一座，风容易在湖面掀起波浪。

english: Wooded hills rise south of the Yukon River, between the Birch Creek watershed and the upper Yukon country of the Hän. The Dendoo Gwich’in lived across much of the country south of the river, including the surrounding mountain ranges. Families travelled between rivers and uplands to hunt and fish, following the seasons. Farther east, Hän hunters also used the hills above the Yukon for caribou and sheep.
simp_chinese: 育空河南方，森林覆盖的丘陵位于桦树溪流域与汗人的上育空地区之间。登杜哥威迅人生活在河流以南的广阔地区，包括周围的山脉。各家庭随季节在河流与高地之间往来，狩猎捕鱼。更靠东的汗人猎手也在育空河上方的山丘猎取驯鹿和野羊。

english: The Great Bahama Bank is an immense shallow carbonate platform east of Florida. Much of its submerged surface lies only a few metres beneath the sea, with islands and cays rising above the banks at its margins. The deep Tongue of the Ocean cuts into the platform beside Andros, providing a striking contrast to the surrounding flats.
