后来工业发展改变了聚落规模和名称，其位置仍系于鄂毕河冲积平原。地方历史因而始于西伯利亚大河走廊旁的森林草原小社群，处在农耕、河运以及斯拉夫移民与阿尔泰原住民接触的地貌中。

english:
Chester stands on the River Dee within walls whose origins reach back to its Roman fortress. In the Middle Ages it became an important port for trade with Ireland and continental Europe, while its castle guarded the approach to north Wales. Merchants' shops and houses lined the streets of the walled city.

Chester's position made it valuable to Charles I during the Civil War, particularly as a port and a link with Ireland across the sea. Parliamentary forces besieged the Royalist city, breaching its walls and cutting off supplies to the inhabitants. After a long siege marked by hunger and bombardment, Chester surrendered in February 1646. Its ancient defences had once more become the scene of a struggle for control of the borderlands.
simp_chinese:
切斯特位于迪河畔，城墙源自罗马时代的堡垒。中世纪它成为与爱尔兰和欧洲大陆贸易的重要港口，城堡则守卫通往北威尔士的入口。商人的店铺与住宅排列在城墙内的街道上。

英国内战中，切斯特的位置使它对查理一世十分重要，尤其是作为通往爱尔兰的联系。议会军围攻王党控制的城市，攻破城墙并切断供应。经历饥饿和炮击的漫长围困后，切斯特于1646年2月投降。古老防御工事再次成为争夺边境地区控制权的战场。

english:
Chesterfield is a market town in northeastern Derbyshire, east of the Peak District. Its planned medieval market place grew west of the older settlement around the parish church. A royal charter in 1204 confirmed the town as a borough and gave its burgesses trading privileges; the market brought together people from the surrounding countryside.

The parish church of St Mary and All Saints has a distinctive twisted and leaning spire, probably completed in the fourteenth century. Between 1500 and 1800 Chesterfield prospered through commerce and crafts including leatherworking and brewing. Rebuilding changed its houses and workshops, but much of the medieval street pattern endured. In 1598 a new charter gave the town the right to elect a mayor, and Ralph Clarke became its first holder of the office.
simp_chinese:
切斯特菲尔德是德比郡东北部的一座集镇，位于峰区高地以东。中世纪规划的市场广场建在教区教堂附近旧聚落的西侧。1204年的王室特许状确认了城镇的自治市地位，并赋予市民贸易特权；市场吸引周围乡村的人们前来交易。

圣玛丽及诸圣教区教堂有一座醒目的扭曲倾斜尖塔，可能于十四世纪建成。1500至1800年间，切斯特菲尔德凭借商业、皮革加工和酿造等行当逐渐兴盛。房屋和作坊经过重建，中世纪的街道格局却大体延续下来。1598年，新的特许状赋予城镇选举市长的权利，拉尔夫·克拉克成为首任市长。

english:
Chesterfield Inlet reaches inland from the western shore of Hudson Bay to Baker Lake, which receives the waters of the Thelon River. Inuit hunters gathered at the mouth of this long waterway in late spring and early summer to hunt seals, and Thule Inuit used the area as a summer settlement. The inlet connects the coastal hunting grounds with a vast country of lakes and rivers farther inland.

European navigators looking for a northwest passage took an interest in the inlet in the eighteenth century. In 1747 William Moor identified it as a possible route west, and the Hudson's Bay Company sent further expeditions to investigate. William Christopher travelled through the inlet to the end of Baker Lake in 1762, showing that it did not provide the passage to Asia sought by the explorers.
simp_chinese:
切斯特菲尔德湾从哈得孙湾西岸深入内陆，直通接纳塞隆河水的贝克湖。晚春和初夏，因纽特猎人在这条漫长水道的入口聚集，猎捕海豹；图勒因纽特人也曾在附近的夏季营地生活。海湾将沿岸猎场与内陆广阔的湖泊、河流地带连接起来。

十八世纪，寻找西北航道的欧洲航海者对这条海湾产生了兴趣。1747年，威廉·穆尔认为它可能是一条向西的路线，哈得孙湾公司随后派出探险队继续查探。1762年，威廉·克里斯托弗沿海湾抵达贝克湖尽头，证明这里并非探险者所寻求的通往亚洲的航道。

english: Chestowee was a Yuchi town in the Tennessee country, inhabited by a people whose own name, Tsoyaha, means “Children of the Sun.” In 1714, two English fur traders from South Carolina encouraged the Cherokee to attack it. The Cherokee destroyed the town and prepared to carry their attacks against other Yuchi settlements along the Savannah River, though the colonial government did not support a further expedition. The destruction of Chestowee marked the growing power of the Cherokee in the southeastern interior.
simp_chinese: 切斯托维是田纳西地区的一座尤奇人城镇。尤奇人自称措亚哈，意为“太阳之子”。1714年，两名来自南卡罗来纳的英国毛皮商人怂恿切罗基人进攻此地。切罗基人摧毁了城镇，并准备继续攻击萨凡纳河沿岸的其他尤奇聚落，但殖民政府没有支持进一步远征。切斯托维的毁灭标志着切罗基人在东南内陆的力量日益增长。

english: The Chet Irgiz is a tributary of the Irgiz in the dry steppe east of the Mugodzhar Hills. Its waters join a river that runs south from the hills towards the Turgay, within a basin that has no outlet to the ocean. The rivers and lakes of this country form a chain of seasonal wetlands amid the open plains, with their extent changing as the supply of water rises and falls.
simp_chinese: 切特伊尔吉兹河是伊尔吉兹河的支流，流经穆戈扎尔丘陵以东的干燥草原。它汇入从丘陵向南流往托尔盖河的河流，属于没有大洋出口的内陆流域。河流与湖泊在开阔平原上形成一连串季节性湿地，其范围随水量涨落而变化。

english: Wiaqajk, “the mixing place,” is the Mi'kmaw name for the Margaree country of western Cape Breton. The Northeast and Southwest Margaree rivers meet before flowing into the Gulf of St. Lawrence, with wooded hills and broad floodplains along their course. For the Mi'kmaq the river provided food and a route linking the interior of Unama'ki with the coast. Its waters supported salmon, whose seasonal movements were an important part of life along the river.
simp_chinese: 维阿卡吉克意为“汇合之地”，是布雷顿角西部马加里地区的米克马克语名称。东北和西南马加里河汇合后流入圣劳伦斯湾，沿岸有林木覆盖的丘陵和宽广河漫滩。米克马克人从河流获取食物，并沿河往来于乌纳马基克内陆与海岸。河中栖息着鲑鱼，它们的季节性洄游是沿河生活的重要部分。

english: Chetilla lies in the Chotano river basin of the northern Peruvian highlands. Its archaeological remains include pottery from communities that occupied the region before the Spanish conquest. The surrounding mountains and valleys form part of the Cajamarca highlands, a landscape where settlements maintained connections along river courses and across the ridges of the northern Andes.
simp_chinese: 切蒂亚位于秘鲁北部高地的乔塔诺河流域。当地考古遗迹中有西班牙征服之前居住在此的社群制作的陶器。周围山谷属于卡哈马卡高地，聚落沿河道和越过北安第斯山脊保持联系。

english: Chewalla lies in the wooded country of western Tennessee, a region once claimed and used by the Chickasaw. Its name is of Indigenous origin, preserved in the landscape after the growth of American settlement. In 1818 Chickasaw leaders signed a treaty ceding their claim to lands between the Tennessee and Mississippi rivers north of the Mississippi boundary. Settlers subsequently moved into the region, laying out farms among its streams and forests.
simp_chinese: 切瓦拉位于田纳西西部的林地，奇克索人曾在这一地区活动并主张土地权利。这个名字源于原住民语言，在美国人定居扩张后仍保留在地名中。1818年，奇克索首领签署条约，将密西西比州边界以北、田纳西河与密西西比河之间土地的权利割让给美国。此后移民进入这一地区，在溪流与森林之间开辟农场。

english: The Chewaucan River descends from the mountains into a dry basin of the northern Great Basin, crossing marshes before reaching the shallow waters of Lake Abert. The lake has no outlet, and its water is salty. Northern Paiute bands have long made their home in the basin; Paiute and Klamath people came to the river and marshes to gather the edible tubers of wapato. In the Klamath language the plant was called chewa, a name carried by the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 切瓦坎河从山中流入大盆地北部的干旱盆地，穿过沼泽，最终注入浅浅的阿伯特湖。湖水没有出口，因此带有咸味。北派尤特人的支系长期生活在这片盆地中；派尤特人与克拉马斯人来到河畔和沼泽，采集慈姑可食用的块茎。克拉马斯语称这种植物为“chewa”，周围地区也由此得名。

english:
Chezdi-Oșorheiu, known in Hungarian as Kézdivásárhely, stands in Székely Land, the eastern Carpathian country of valleys and hills inhabited mainly by Székelys, a Hungarian-speaking people. Its Hungarian name means 'Kézdi Market', after Kézdi, one of the Székely seats, autonomous units with their own administrative systems. The town was first mentioned in 1407 as Torjawasara, meaning 'Torja Market', and its status as a market town dates back to the Middle Ages.

Local identity was carried through scattered communities, customary rights and a collective territorial structure rather than through a single dominant capital. The broader cultural heart of the region was Târgu Mureș, while the landscape also contained villages, fortified churches, castles, and mountain passes.
simp_chinese:
凯兹迪－奥绍尔海乌即匈牙利语的凯兹迪瓦绍尔赫伊，位于塞凯伊地，这片东喀尔巴阡的河谷与丘陵地带主要居住着讲匈牙利语的塞凯伊人。其匈牙利语名意为“凯兹迪市场”，得名于塞凯伊席地之一的凯兹迪；席地是拥有自身行政体系的自治单位。城镇于1407年以托尔亚瓦萨拉之名首次见于记载，意为“托尔亚市场”，其集市地位可追溯至中世纪。

当地认同依托分散的村镇、习惯权利和共同地域结构延续，并未集中于单一强势首府。更广阔区域的文化中心是特尔古穆列什，地景中还包括村庄、设防教堂、城堡和山口。

english:
Chhaparagarh stands at the junction of the Wainganga and the Motinala, north of Seoni. Its square fort has corner towers and an eastern gate, with the river and stream protecting two sides. Tradition attributes the settlement and fort to Ram Singh, a relative of Bakht Buland, the Gond ruler of Deogarh. Chhapara became a local seat of authority in the wooded country between the Narmada and Wainganga.

Ram Singh established himself here in 1703. Later in the eighteenth century, the Pathan governor Muhammad Amir Khan moved his headquarters from Chhapara to Seoni. At the beginning of the nineteenth century the town had a substantial garrison but suffered Pindari raids. Its fort and riverside position preserve the memory of a once important centre of the Deogarh and Nagpur territories.
simp_chinese:
查帕拉加尔位于瑟奥尼以北、瓦因甘加河与莫蒂纳拉溪汇合处。方形堡垒四角建有塔楼，东面设城门，河流与溪水保护着其中两侧。传统认为聚落和堡垒由德奥加尔贡德统治者巴赫特·布兰德的亲属拉姆·辛格创建。查帕拉成为讷尔默达河与瓦因甘加河之间林地的地方权力中心。

拉姆·辛格于1703年在此建立驻地。十八世纪后期，帕坦总督穆罕默德·阿米尔汗将驻地从查帕拉迁往瑟奥尼。十九世纪初，城镇驻有相当数量的军队，却遭到品达里人劫掠。堡垒及其河畔位置保存了这座德奥加尔与那格浦尔领土中昔日重要中心的记忆。

english: Chhatarpur lies on the Bundelkhand plateau and takes its name from the Bundela ruler Chhatrasal. In the early eighteenth century the surrounding country formed part of his kingdom of Panna. After his death, disputes among his successors divided the region into smaller states. In 1785 Kunwar Sone Shah Ponwar seized the Chhatarpur estate from his young master Hira Singh and founded a state with its seat at Chhatarpur.
simp_chinese: 切德尔布尔位于本德尔肯德高原，以本德拉统治者查特拉萨尔命名。十八世纪初，周边地区属于他的潘纳王国；他死后，继承人之间的争斗使这一带分裂为较小的邦国。1785年，孔瓦尔·索内沙·蓬瓦尔从年幼的主人希拉·辛格手中夺取切德尔布尔领地，建立以此地为中心的邦国。

english: Chhaya lies near the coast of western Saurashtra, inland from Porbandar. It was a seat of the Jethwa rulers after their earlier centres at Ghumli and Ranpur. The family later shifted its capital to the port of Porbandar, where maritime trade offered access to the Arabian Sea. Chhaya remained part of the Jethwa domain, linking the coastal town with the agricultural and hilly country behind it.
simp_chinese: 查亚位于索拉什特拉西部海岸附近、波尔班达尔内陆。它曾是杰特瓦统治者的驻地，此前他们的中心位于古姆利和兰布尔。家族后来将都城迁往波尔班达尔港，利用海上贸易通向阿拉伯海。查亚仍属于杰特瓦领地，将沿海城镇与背后的农业地区和山地相连。

english:
Chhmuoh Thmei lies in the eastern Mekong delta on the Vàm Cỏ Tây, the western branch of the Vàm Cỏ River. Vietnamese settlers entered this watery region in the late seventeenth century, joining older communities along its banks. In 1705 the Bảo Định canal linked the river near Tân An with the Tiền River at Mỹ Tho, creating a passage between two important waterways across the low plain.

The later city of Tân An lies here.
simp_chinese:
初莫泰位于湄公河三角洲东部的西汪草河畔。十七世纪末，越南移民进入这片水网地区，与沿岸原有社群共同生活。1705年开凿的保定运河将新安附近的西汪草河与美萩的前江连接起来，为两条重要水道之间提供了穿越低平原的通路。

后来的新安即位于此地。

english: Chi La lies in the country of the La River, south of the lower Lam River. At Tam Soa the Ngàn Sâu and Ngàn Phố meet to form the La, bringing waters from the forested mountains of the interior towards the coastal plain. The old name Chi La was associated with the district later called La Sơn, a region of river crossings and villages between the hills and the larger Lam valley.
simp_chinese: 支罗位于蓝江下游以南的罗河地区。从内陆森林覆盖的山地一路流来的千深河与千铺河在三岔汇合，形成罗河，流向沿海平原。支罗这一古名与后来称为罗山的地方辖区相联系；这里的渡口和村落分布在周围山丘与更宽广的蓝江谷地之间，沿着河流连接两岸的居民。

english:
Chiaha was a fortified Indigenous town on a river island in the Appalachian country. Maize fields lined the banks, and its people belonged to a network of Mississippian communities connected with the powerful chiefdom of Coosa to the south. The town's setting between branches of the river gave it a natural measure of protection as well as access to fertile ground.

Hernando de Soto's expedition reached Chiaha in 1540 after crossing the mountains. The inhabitants supplied food while the Spaniards rested their exhausted horses, but relations broke down when de Soto demanded women. The people withdrew to a nearby island; a negotiated truce supplied the expedition with porters, but no women. Juan Pardo's expedition visited the region a generation later and established a small Spanish fort, which did not survive the subsequent Indigenous resistance.
simp_chinese:
奇亚哈是阿巴拉契亚地区一座位于河中岛屿上的设防原住民城镇。河岸分布着玉米田，居民属于密西西比文化社群网络，并与南方强大的库萨酋邦保持联系。城镇坐落在河流分支之间，既获得天然防护，也靠近肥沃土地。

1540年，埃尔南多·德索托的远征队翻越群山后抵达奇亚哈。居民提供食物，西班牙人则让疲惫的马匹休养；但德索托要求妇女随行后，双方关系破裂。居民撤到附近一座岛上，最后经谈判达成休战，向远征队提供搬运者，但没有交出妇女。约一代人后，胡安·帕尔多的远征队来到这一地区并建立一座小堡，堡垒未能抵挡后来的原住民抵抗。

english: Chiametlan, also known as Chametla, lies beside the Baluarte River on the southern Sinaloa coast. Before the Spanish conquest it was inhabited by Totorame people, whose communities occupied the coastal plain and river valleys. In 1531 Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán’s forces seized the settlement after fighting its inhabitants. The Spanish founded a villa there as they advanced north toward Culiacán, bringing the region into the violent expansion of New Galicia.
simp_chinese: 恰梅特兰也称查梅特拉，坐落在锡那罗亚南部海岸的巴卢阿特河畔。西班牙征服之前，托托拉梅人居住于此，其社区分布在沿海平原和河谷。1531年，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的军队与当地居民交战后夺取聚落，并在向北进军库利亚坎途中建立西班牙镇。新加利西亚的暴力扩张由此进入这一地区。

english: Chiang Dao lies north of Chiang Mai in the upper Ping valley, beneath the towering limestone massif of Doi Luang Chiang Dao. The mountains contain caves and forests, while the river valley offers cultivable land amid the rugged highlands. The great peak rises above the surrounding ridges and has long been a landmark for communities in this part of the northern Thai country.
simp_chinese: 清道位于清迈以北的宾河上游河谷，高耸的清道山石灰岩山体俯瞰其地。山中有森林和洞穴，河谷则在崎岖的高地之间提供了可供耕种的土地。巍峨山峰高出周围群岭，长久以来一直是泰北这一带居民熟悉的地标。

english:
Chiang Khan lies on the Thai bank of the Mekong in northern Loei, where the Hueang and Loei rivers join a wider borderland facing Laos. Forested hills rise behind the riverbank, while sandbars, rapids and floodplain gardens follow the Mekong. Fish from the river and produce from upland villages met at landing places used by Lao communities on both banks.

Before a formal town developed, the Mekong formed a corridor of movement and exchange rather than a complete boundary. Lao villages shared speech, kinship and river knowledge across the water. Boats carried salt, cloth, metal, forest goods and food between the Loei country, Vientiane and the Lao interior. Market places and monasteries gathered along the most convenient banks and river crossings.

Territorial conflict and the drawing of borders later changed the routes, while settlement concentrated more strongly on the Thai side. The river remained the central fact of the place: fishing, gardens and low-water sandbars shaped seasonal life, and roads reached the riverbank through the hills. Chiang Khan’s identity belongs to this Mekong frontier, where Lao society and long-distance river travel preceded state boundaries.
simp_chinese:
清堪位于泰国黎府北部的湄公河岸，会河与黎河在面向老挝的广阔边境地区汇入大河。林木丘陵在河岸后方隆起，沙洲、急流和洪泛园圃沿湄公河分布。河中鱼类与高地村庄的农产品在两岩老挝社群使用的登陆点汇合。

正式城镇形成以前，湄公河更像人员与货物往来的走廊，而非完整边界。两岸老挝村庄共享语言、亲缘和河流知识。船只把盐、布匹、金属、林产品和食物运往黎府地区、万象及老挝内地。市场与寺院聚集在河岸便利和渡口位置。

后来的领土冲突与边界划定改变了路线，泰国一侧的聚落更加集中。河流仍是地方的核心事实：捕鱼、园圃和低水位沙洲塑造季节生活，道路穿越丘陵抵达河岸。清堪的身份属于这一湄公河边疆，老挝社会与长途河运早在国家边界形成前便塑造了地区。河岸因此长期维系往来。

english:
Chiang Khong occupies broad intermontane basins of the Phi Pan Nam mountains in northeastern Chiang Rai province. The Mekong bounds the district on the north and northeast and separates it from Laos, while the Ing River carries water from the interior toward the great river. West of the town, Doi Luang Pae Mueang rises 1,328 metres, forming a prominent massif above the settled lowland. This arrangement of river and mountain placed Chiang Khong among the river towns of the northern Tai country, where transport and exchange followed the Mekong and its valleys.

Chiang Khong lay about 35 kilometres downstream of Chiang Saen, the Mekong town founded in 1329 by Saenphu, a grandson of King Mangrai of Lan Na. The Chiang Saen area stood on a trade route toward Yunnan, and the river towns below it shared that frontier world. Lan Na was ruled from Burma from 1558 to 1774, and in 1804 Siamese troops took Chiang Saen. Farming on the river flats and trade along the Mekong sustained a town on the border between the Tai principalities of the north.
simp_chinese:
清孔位于清莱府东北部披潘南山脉的宽阔山间盆地。湄公河环绕其北面和东北面，将其与老挝分开；英河则把腹地来水带向大河。城镇以西，隆培孟山高1328米，在低地聚落上方形成显著山体。河流与山地的这种配置，使清孔处在北部泰人地区的河畔城镇之间，往来与交换沿湄公河及其河谷展开。

清孔位于清盛下游约35公里处。清盛是孟莱王之孙森普于1329年在湄公河畔建立的城镇，清盛一带处在通往云南的商路上，其下游的河畔城镇同属这个边地世界。兰纳在1558年至1774年由缅甸统治，1804年暹罗军队攻取清盛。河滩上的农耕和沿湄公河的贸易，维系着这座位于北方泰人诸邦边界的城镇。

english:
In 1296 the Thai king Mangrai of the upper Mae Ping valley founded a new capital he called #italic Chiang Mai#!, the New City, completing his unification of the Lan Na, the Land of a Million Rice Fields, in the mountain valleys of northern Siam. The site was chosen with the help of the kings of Sukhothai and Phayao, and its walls and moat were laid out around a central square, a sacred plan that fuses Mon, Thai, and Khmer traditions. Under Mangrai and his successors the city flourished as a center of Theravada Buddhism and craft, its monasteries patronizing the bronze casters who make the Lan Na statues prized across the Buddhist world.

The city's great age came under Tilokaraj, who seized the throne from his own father in 1441 and spent much of his reign fighting Ayutthaya for the old Sukhothai lands. He finished the vast chedi of Wat Chedi Luang, then the largest building in Lan Na, and set the Emerald Buddha in its eastern niche, and in 1477 monks gathered near the city for a Buddhist council to recompile the Tripitaka.

After his death, quarrels among the princes left Lan Na open to its neighbours. An earthquake in 1545 brought down the top of the great chedi, the Emerald Buddha soon left for Luang Prabang, and in 1558 the Burmese king Bayinnaung took Chiang Mai. Burmese rule, broken by revolts, lasted more than two centuries, until Kawila of Lampang and the Siamese drove the Burmese out in 1775. The wars that followed emptied the city, and from 1776 until 1791 Chiang Mai stood abandoned, its temples falling into ruin.
simp_chinese:
1296年，上湄平河谷的泰王孟莱建立了一座新都城，名为#italic 清迈#!，意为“新城”。至此，他完成了对北暹罗山地河谷兰纳地区（百万稻田之地）的统一。建城选址得到了素可泰与帕尧国王的协助，城墙与护城河围绕中央方形城区而筑，其神圣的布局融合了孟人、泰人与高棉人的传统。在孟莱及其继任者的治下，该城作为上座部佛教与工艺中心而繁荣发展，得到寺庙资助的铸铜工匠所铸造的兰纳佛像成为佛教世界的珍宝。

清迈的鼎盛期在滴洛拉王治下。他在1441年从自己父亲手中夺取王位，在位期间多半在与大城争夺素可泰故地。他完成了契迪龙寺的大佛塔，这是当时兰纳最大的建筑，玉佛就供奉在塔东侧的佛龛里；1477年，僧众在城郊举行佛教结集，重新校订三藏。

滴洛拉死后，诸王子内争不断，兰纳无力抵御邻国。1545年一场地震震塌了大佛塔的塔顶，玉佛不久被迁往琅勃拉邦，1558年缅甸国王莽应龙攻取清迈。缅甸的统治虽屡遭叛乱，仍延续了两个多世纪，直到1775年南邦的卡威拉联合暹罗军队赶走缅军。此后战事不断，城中人口散尽，从1776年到1791年，清迈一直空无人烟，寺庙日渐倾颓。
